jobs.title: Liquor Sales Specialist
jobs.desc:
Turn your knowledge of spirits into standout guest experiences, from tastings and cocktail conversations to premium liquor sales at sea.
We’re looking for
Liquor Sales Specialists
to join our onboard retail teams, working on cruise ships around the world.
This role is for someone who knows their way around premium spirits and enjoys sharing that knowledge with others. You might come from a retail liquor background, duty free, hospitality, bar work, mixology or brand ambassador experience. What matters is that you can talk confidently about different spirits, explain flavour profiles, recommend products and create a tasting experience that guests remember.
About Harding+
Harding+ is a leading cruise retail business, working closely with cruise line partners and brand partners to make every cruise better. Our onboard boutiques offer guests a carefully selected range across liquor, fragrance, beauty, fashion, jewellery, watches, confectionery and logo products.
We are proud to have been recognised as Cruise Retailer of the Year in 2022, 2023 and 2025, reflecting our focus on excellent service, strong brand partnerships and memorable guest experiences.
What You’ll Do
As a
Liquor Sales Specialist
, you’ll be the person who helps guests discover, understand and enjoy our premium liquor range. You’ll introduce products with confidence, explain the difference between spirits, talk through flavour notes and make recommendations that feel relevant to the guest, whether they are buying a gift, choosing something for an occasion or treating themselves.
You’ll support tastings, seminars, in-store events and promotional activity, using these moments to create interest, start conversations and convert sales. You’ll be comfortable holding the attention of a small group, answering questions and making the experience feel relaxed, enjoyable and informative.
This is a hands-on sales role. You’ll need to approach guests naturally, spot buying signals, suggest complementary products and keep momentum without making the interaction feel forced. You’ll also help maintain strong visual standards, accurate stock handling and compliance processes, while sharing your product knowledge with the wider team.
What You’ll Bring
We’re looking for someone with strong knowledge of spirits and experience using that knowledge in a customer-facing environment.
You’ll Bring
Experience in liquor retail, duty free, hospitality, mixology, bar work, brand ambassador work or premium retail
Strong knowledge of different spirits, such as whisky, rum, gin, vodka, tequila, cognac or liqueurs
Confidence discussing flavour profiles, serves, cocktail ideas, gifting options and brand stories
The ability to host or support tastings, demonstrations, seminars or promotional events
Motivation and ambition to achieve sales targets and maximise every sales opportunity
A positive, team-focused attitude and willingness to share knowledge
Fluency in English; additional languages would be an advantage
A good level of physical fitness, as the role involves being active throughout the day
What You’ll Get
Competitive salary with target-based commission
Included Accommodation and meals provided onboard
No household bills while you are working at sea
Support with necessary visas and seafaring documents
Dedicated in-house training across sales, product and brand knowledge
The opportunity to travel the world while earning
Contracts of up to 6 months onboard, usually followed by 1 to 2 months at home between contracts
On selected cruise lines, the opportunity to travel independently after your contract, with support for your return travel home afterwards
Ready to bring your spirits knowledge to sea? Apply Now!

jobs.desc:
Keeper Security is hiring a Legal Counsel to support our corporate legal team. The Legal Counsel will play a key cross-functional role in supporting efforts including employment, litigation and disputes as well as supporting commercial contracting needs. Qualified candidates must permanently reside in Ireland. This is a hybrid position for those living within a commutable distance to our Cork, Ireland office.
Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of users and thousands of organizations, globally. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and be responsible for providing legal support across a range of legal matters.
About Keeper
Keeper Security is a leading cybersecurity software company that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in more than 150 countries. Keeper delivers a powerful zero-trust and zero-knowledge solution built to meet the stringent requirements of public sector IT environments. Its flagship offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects users, devices and critical infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized in the Gartner® Magic QuadrantTM for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper combines robust compliance with unmatched visibility and control. With industry-leading certifications, Keeper provides the security assurance public sector organizations require. Learn why agencies trust Keeper to defend against today’s sophisticated adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.
Job Summary
As a Legal Counsel with Keeper, you will serve as a key advisor to the entire company, working closely with the HR, Marketing, Infosec, Compliance and Engineering teams on day to day and strategic legal matters. This is a highly collaborative role, requiring excellent legal acumen, strong communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Responsibilities
Manage and resolve employment-related legal matters, including advising HR on hiring, performance management, internal investigations and compliance with employment laws
Oversee litigation and dispute resolution efforts, including managing outside counsel, developing litigation strategy and resolving pre-litigation disputes
Coordinate and support commercial procurement by reviewing and advising on service provider engagements, agreements and compliance requirements; collaborate with procurement and business teams on process improvements
Advise internal stakeholders on deal structures and contribute to negotiating commercial contracts, including SaaS, partnerships, licensing and services agreements
Support other legal matters and strategic initiatives as assigned
Collaborate with and support all internal teams to identify, mitigate, resolve and escalate cross-functional risks and disputes
Drive continuous improvements to Keeper's legal processes, policies and templates
Work closely with business stakeholders and other departments to ensure alignment between legal matters and company goals
Requirements
Law degree and registration in good standing with the Law Society of Ireland
3+ years of experience in an in-house legal role, with experience supporting a broad range of matters, particularly employment, litigation and disputes as well as being able to support commercial contracting
Experience with SaaS technology, IP, partner ecosystems and privacy matters a plus
Proactive, analytical, interpersonal and problem-solving skills
Strong attention to detail, outstanding communication and critical thinking skills - able to understand and distill complex legal issues clearly and concisely
Strong organizational and time management skills to balance multiple priorities under tight deadlines

jobs.title: Customer Assistant - Ballincollig Express
jobs.desc:
About the role
We pride ourselves on offering customers the biggest range of products around. And that's not just food, but everything from clothes and kettles to financial services.
But did you know we offer the biggest job opportunities too? With stores across the UK and Ireland, and a variety of roles, we are always looking for people who are as passionate about helping customers as we are.
Our Every Little Helps approach doesn't just apply to our customers. It's at the very heart of everything we do at work - and it's what makes us different. Able to give great, natural customer service by proactively smiling, greeting, acknowledging and helping customers.

Adaptable and resilient to meet the ever changing demands of our business.
You must be able to follow instructions either verbal or written.
You are reliable and a good timekeeper.
You must be smart and tidy at all times.
Whats in it for you?
We offer excellent benefits that help make Tesco a great place to work. These include but aren't limited to:
Competitive Salary
Bonus Scheme*
Our Virtual GP service provides free and confidential access to an online GP through video GP consultations, and online prescription service for colleagues. The service is also available to families of colleagues who live at the same address for a reduced cost.
24/7 access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for you and family members for in the moment emotional support along with free access to a range of wellbeing services supporting you under our new Wellbeing First approach of Body, Mind and Life.
Colleague Clubcard offering 10% discount across stores and online, with 15% discount weekends once a month (Friday to Sunday), and 20% off twice a year. There is also 20% off F&F clothing, all year long, these various discounts can be extended to a family member with a 2nd Clubcard available.*
Life Assurance
Pension Plan*
Save As You Earn Scheme*

Bike to Work
Long Service Awards
Commuter Scheme

About Us
Our vision at Tesco is to become every customer's favourite way to shop, whether they are at home or out on the move. Our core purpose is "Serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day". Serving means more than a transactional relationship with our customers. It means acting as a responsible and sustainable business for all stakeholders, for the communities we are part of, and for the planet. Through initiatives like the Tesco Community Fund, our association with Children's Health Foundation, our partnership with FoodCloud and our Stronger Starts programme, we have supported over 21,000 community groups, raised over €7.5 million for medical equipment, and provided almost 15 million meals nationwide, to those living in food insecurity.
Tesco has operated in the Irish retail market since 1997, and with 190+ stores nationwide, we employ over 13,000 people in cities and towns around Ireland, supporting almost 45,000 jobs directly and indirectly. We partner with over 500 Irish suppliers - of which almost three-quarters are small and medium enterprises - which in turn supports almost 13,000 farming families around Ireland. Tesco is the single largest buyer of Irish food and drink in the world, buying €1.6 Billion a year; more than any other single country in the European Union, more than even the USA which you perceive as a massive buyer of Irish food.
We work closely with suppliers across Ireland who are dedicated to making the best products for our customers and this is reflected in the numerous awards our products have won over the years including Blás Na hÉireann, World Steak Challenge and Great Taste Awards.
We are proud to have an inclusive culture at Tesco where everyone truly feels able to be themselves. It is embedded in our values: we treat people how they want to be treated. At Tesco, we not only celebrate diversity, but recognise the value and opportunity it brings. We always want our colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work and we are committed to helping them be at their best.
We know life looks a little different for each of us. That's why at Tesco, we always welcome chats about flexible working. Some people are at the start of their careers, some want the freedom to do the things they love. Others are going through life-changing moments like becoming a carer, nearing retirement, adapting to parenthood, or something else. So, talk to us throughout your application about how we can support.
Tesco is committed to celebrating diversity and everyone is welcome at Tesco. We're committed to providing a fully inclusive recruitment process, allowing candidates the opportunity to thrive and inform us of any reasonable adjustments they may require. For further information on the accessibility support we can offer, please click http://roi.tesco-careers.com/accessibility/

This will allow us to understand more about you and how we can best support you through the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Product Security
jobs.desc:
About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
Principal Engineer, Product Security
The Role
Analog Devices is seeking a Principal Engineer, Product Security Champion to drive product security through the full product lifecycle, from early definition through release and post-release support. This role sits inside the core security enablement team and owns day-to-day product security leadership for programs. The Security Champion serves as the central point of accountability for product security decisions, ensures the required security assurance evidence is created, works with the Product Security Assurance team and the assigned security architect, and acts as the product contact for post-release security incident response activities. The role also helps align product security goals with customer expectations, applicable standards, implementation feasibility, and long-term product support needs in alignment with the program owner.
Essential Duties And Responsibilities
Own the product security workstream for the program and serve as the primary point of accountability for security across the product lifecycle. Products in scope are: digital and mixed signal chips, modules, subsystems and software.
Define and maintain the product security posture, including product-level security requirements, objectives, and supporting assumptions.
Ensure the evidence is created to demonstrate that security assurance practices are followed during development.
Act as the main point of contact with the Product Security Assurance team and the assigned Security Advisor for development-phase security questions and assurance activities.
Shape security requirements, architecture decisions, threat analysis inputs, and security IP selection.
Align with the product owner, product architect, software teams, and engineering stakeholders so security decisions fit the product scope, architecture, cost, schedule, and intended use.
Engage key customers when needed to validate security objectives, threat assumptions, and expected security posture for the target application.
Drive compliance planning and execution for applicable standards, regulations, certifications, and Secure Development Life Cycle deliverables.
Oversee security implementation, secure development practices, verification activities, provisioning-related security actions, and product security continuity after release.
Act as the product point of contact for post-release security incident response activities and organize response actions when vulnerabilities or incidents arise.
Maintain continuity of security through product lifetime, including support for remediation, maintenance obligations, and end-of-life security activities.
Minimum Qualifications
Completion of security training or certification
Demonstrated ~10 year experience to secure development processes, product security implementation, and security assurance practices in product programs following established standards.
Working knowledge of relevant standards, regulatory frameworks, and industry security practices applicable to the target market (e.g. IEC62443, ISO21434, US FDA, EU CRA).
Strong understanding of security requirements and how they apply at the product level: hardware System-on-Chip architectures, Secure Boot, Hardware cryptography, Embedded Software security. 3+ years of experience in silicon SoC security architecture and design preferred.
Solid technical background spanning software, hardware, network and cloud security attached to embedded or connected products.
Ability to work effectively across product, architecture, software, hardware, quality, and assurance teams.
Additional Skills, Knowledge And Abilities
Ability to explain security decisions clearly and build trust with internal stakeholders and customers.
Ability to translate market, customer, and regulatory inputs into actionable product security requirements and plans.
Ability to manage long-lived security ownership, including compliance evidence, certifications, and post-release maintenance expectations or products.
Comfort operating in cross-functional product teams where security cuts across architecture, implementation, verification, manufacturing, and operational support.

As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.

Why Start Your Career at S&W?
Starting your career is about more than just a job. It's about the people you learn from, the relationships you build and the experiences that shape you. Whether that's passing an exam, achieving a personal milestone or celebrating success with your colleagues, you'll be part of a team that's invested in your growth, celebrates your achievements and supports you to be yourself.
At S&W, you'll be given meaningful responsibility from the start, alongside the support and guidance needed to help you succeed. You'll learn from experienced colleagues, develop valuable professional skills and build confidence as your career progresses.
As a growing accountancy and advisory firms, we offer a balance of opportunity and support. You'll learn from people at every level of the business, gain exposure to a variety of clients, industries and experiences, and develop the skills, knowledge and confidence needed to build a successful career.
The Accountancy Team at S&W
Our Business Outsourcing Services team helps businesses manage their finances, meet their reporting requirements and improve the effectiveness of their finance functions. Working with clients of different sizes, sectors and stages of growth, you'll gain first-hand experience of how businesses operate while helping them navigate day-to-day challenges and achieve their ambitions.
What sets S&W apart is the breadth of experience you'll gain from the start. You'll work closely with a diverse range of businesses, gaining exposure to accounting, technology and advisory projects that go beyond traditional compliance work. This breadth of experience, combined with structured training and support, will help you build a strong foundation for a successful career in accountancy and business advisory.
What Will You Be Doing?
As part of our Business Outsourcing Services team, you'll work closely with clients and their finance teams, supporting them with everything from statutory accounts and management reporting to VAT, bookkeeping and cloud accounting solutions. By combining technical expertise with practical advice, you'll help businesses operate more effectively and make better-informed decisions.
Alongside your work, you'll study towards the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) or Chartered Accountants Ireland (CAI) qualification, combining professional training with hands-on experience across a diverse range of clients and industries. This blend of technical learning and practical responsibility will help you develop a deep understanding of accounting, finance and business, providing a strong foundation for a successful career in accountancy and advisory services.
Your work will include:
Working with a diverse range of clients, supporting the delivery of statutory accounts, management accounts, bookkeeping, VAT returns and cloud accounting solutions.
Building an understanding of our clients, their businesses and the challenges and opportunities they face.
Preparing financial information and contributing to the delivery of high-quality client service.
Developing expertise in cloud accounting platforms and digital finance technologies.
Supporting clients with accounting queries, providing practical advice and helping to identify effective solutions.
Using technology and automation to help clients improve efficiency and enhance their finance processes.
Supporting software implementation, system optimisation and finance transformation projects.
Managing priorities across a portfolio of clients while developing strong organisational, commercial and relationship-building skills.
To Be Successful in This Role
You'll be someone who:
Is curious, eager to learn and open to new challenges
Enjoys working with others and building positive relationships
Has a keen eye for detail and enjoys solving problems
Is proactive and looks for ways to make a positive contribution
Takes ownership of their development and is motivated to achieve their goals
You'll also need to:
Be committed to working towards the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) or Chartered Accountants Ireland (CAI) qualification
Have some accountancy experience, as part of your education or work experience
Have obtained or be predicted a minimum 2:2 degree, in any discipline
Minimum 400 Leaving Certificate points (or equivalent)
Leaving Certificate O2 or H5 in Maths and English (or equivalent)
Your Learning & Development
We'll support you throughout your qualification journey with a leading UK training provider, dedicated study time and practical experience that complements your learning.
You'll join as part of a cohort and benefit from a strong support network that includes experienced colleagues, a buddy and our Learning & Development team. From your first day, you'll have people around you to guide you, answer questions and help you make the most of every opportunity.
As a Colleague at S&W, You'll Have Access to Benefits That Include
Fully funded training towards professional qualifications
Competitive salary
Private medical insurance
Life assurance
Pension contribution
Generous holiday package
Option to purchase additional holiday
Cycle to work scheme
Season ticket loan
Eye care support
Shared parental leave
Our Commitment to Inclusion
We are proud to value the differences that a diverse workforce brings, representative of society and our clients. At S&W we have a wide range of highly active employee resource groups and we’re delivering multiple diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives across the organisation. It is our commitment to provide a workspace where all colleagues, regardless of identity, background, or circumstance, feel respected as individuals and feel that they can achieve their full potential and work in a safe, supportive, and inclusive environment.
We are happy to make any reasonable adjustments to accommodate for your needs throughout the application process. Please let your Recruiter know.

jobs.desc:
Responsibilities
The Structural Simulation Engineer will support the structural design and development of Liebherr container cranes through Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and simulation activities. The primary focus of the role will be the assessment and optimisation of crane components and structures using Ansys, including both static and transient/dynamic simulations.
The successful candidate will also have the opportunity to develop skills in multi-body dynamics modelling and control system simulation using MATLAB/Simulink and Simscape Multibody, working closely with structural, automation and control engineering teams.
Key Elements of the Role:
Responsibilities shall include, but are not limited to the following:
Perform structural analysis of crane components and assemblies using the Ansys suite of software.
Conduct static, nonlinear and transient dynamic simulations to support product development and verifi-cation activities.
Evaluate structural strength, stiffness, fatigue performance and dynamic behaviour of crane structures and mechanical systems.
Prepare, review and interpret finite element models, simulation results and technical reports.
Support the development and validation of simulation methodologies and best practices within the de-partment.
Collaborate with design engineers to improve component and system performance through simulation-led design.
Develop and maintain simplified and detailed simulation models for complex mechanical systems.
Support the modelling of crane mechanisms using MATLAB/Simulink and Simscape Multibody.
Collaborate with automation and control engineers to understand the interaction between mechanical systems and control algorithms.
Contribute to the development of simulation tools, automation workflows and engineering processes us-ing Python, Ansys APDL and VBA.
Work with CAD models generated in PTC Creo and prepare geometry for simulation activities.
Constructively collaborate with the simulation engineering community within MCC and the broader Liebherr Group.
Qualifications, Requirements & Experience
The successful candidate will hold a third-level qualification in an engineering discipline – preferably L9 or L10.
A strong interest in engineering simulation, numerical methods and analytical problem solving.
Knowledge of Finite Element Analysis principles is essential.
Experience with Ansys Mechanical or similar FEA software is desirable.
Knowledge of structural mechanics, strength of materials and dynamics.
Exposure to transient or dynamic analysis methods would be advantageous.
Experience with MATLAB/Simulink, Simscape Multibody or similar modelling environments would be advantageous.
Experience with CAD software, particularly PTC Creo, would be beneficial.
Basic programming skills are desirable, with Python considered a significant advantage.
Demonstrated aptitude for learning new software tools, simulation techniques and engineering methodologies.

Folláin is Ireland's No.1 preserves brand, made in West Cork since 1983. We're a multi-award-winning, family-owned and -operated producer of high-quality preserves and sauces based in Ballyvourney, Co. Cork. As the fastest-growing brand in our category, with a diverse portfolio of products and customers, we're looking for a Sales & Marketing Intern to support our brand-building activity and the continued growth and development of our product portfolio across customers.
This is a genuine 50/50 role: you'll split your time between marketing the brand and working with our sales team and key customers.

• Is creative and digitally savvy, with a strong interest in content creation, social media and digital marketing.
• Knows Instagram, TikTok and Meta advertising well; familiarity with Meta Business Suite, Canva and WooCommerce is an advantage.

• Is well organised and can juggle several projects at once.
• Is comfortable with Excel and working with data to track performance and build reports.

Send your CV and a short cover letter to [email address] by [closing date]. Tell us why Folláin, and share an example of content or a campaign you've created, if you have one.

A RF Power Electronics Engineer is required by CareerWise Recruitment to join our based Cork based MN medical device client. Working within a multi-disciplinary R&D team you have responsibility for new product and process development. Permanent role.
Role
* Design, develop, refine and evaluate electrical components, assemblies and subsystems for electrosurgery medical devices.
* Lead the design and implementation of high-energy electrical subsystems for patient-connected medical devices.
* Translate user, clinical and system-level needs into electrical requirements, specifications and system designs.
* Apply concurrent engineering, rapid prototyping and advanced testing methods to accelerate product development while meeting cost, quality and compliance requirements.
* Provide technical guidance, mentoring and training to team members on product commercialisation, design trade-offs, technology development and complex engineering challenges.
* Contribute to customer-focused design, voice-of-customer activities, competitive strategy and market understanding in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
* Lead and contribute to engineering documentation, Design History File (DHF) content, R&D procedures and standards-based development activities.

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline, with at least 6 years of relevant experience.
* Advanced electrical design expertise across complex components and electronic subsystems for medical devices.
* Strong experience in high-frequency power electronics operating from hundreds of kHz to low MHz frequencies, including resonant and quasi-resonant topologies, custom magnetics, high-voltage DC/DC converters and power amplifiers.
* Hands-on experience designing custom magnetics, including high-frequency isolation transformers.
* Strong understanding of RF engineering, electromagnetics, electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), measurement systems, sensing and control interfaces, particularly in high dv/dt and high common-mode noise environments.
* Proven ability to guide testing, troubleshooting, PCB and cable design, electrical stack-ups, statistical analysis, and manufacturing and test methods.

Information about the Organisation:
The Local Enterprise Offices (LEOs) of Cork County Council lead a strategic programme to strengthen entrepreneurship, accelerate small business growth, and foster an inclusive, resilient local economy across Cork’s towns and rural hinterlands.
There are 31 Local Enterprise Offices (LEO) in Ireland, each available to facilitate access to enterprise services and to promote and support enterprise at a local level. The LEO is the First Stop Shop for anyone seeking information and support on starting or growing a business in Ireland. Each LEO is led by a Head of Enterprise.
Cork County Council has two LEO – Cork North & West, and Cork South.
County Cork has a population of approximately 359,000 citizens. The county is served by 55 elected members representing the populations of its 8 Municipal Districts, Carrigaline (6), Bandon/Kinsale (6), Macroom (6), Cobh (6), East Cork (7), Fermoy (6), Kanturk/Mallow (9) and West Cork (9) and has the largest elected assembly outside of Dublin.
County Cork covers an area of 7,318 square kilometres, which is 11% of the Irish State and makes Cork Ireland's largest county. With 12,211 km of public roads, Cork County Council's transportation network equates to 13.5% of the nation's total. The Council’s Capital Investment Programme for 2023-2025 is €1.3 billion, indicating the extent of its impact across all aspects of life in Cork County.
An opportunity now exists in Cork County Council for the position of Head of Enterprise.
Job Summary/Description:
The Head of Enterprise is a senior role within the Economic Development and Strategic Planning Directorate of Cork County Council. The Head of Enterprise will lead a team charged with delivering a high standard quality system of coordinated and cohesive State support to the micro and small business sector. This is a key position within the Local Enterprise Office (LEO) structure of the Local Authority. The successful candidate will be required to make a significant contribution to the development and implementation of a strategic plan to support enterprise, entrepreneurship and job creation at a local level. Success will be measured by ensuring that the LEO serves as a First Stop Shop to provide services to start, grow and develop micro and small business throughout the County.
A full list of essential requirements is available in the Information Booklet.

About the role
We pride ourselves on offering customers the biggest range of products around. And that's not just food, but everything from clothes and kettles to financial services.
But did you know we offer the biggest job opportunities too? With stores across the UK and Ireland, and a variety of roles, we are always looking for people who are as passionate about helping customers as we are.
Our Every Little Helps approach doesn't just apply to our customers. It's at the very heart of everything we do at work - and it's what makes us different. Able to give great, natural customer service by proactively smiling, greeting, acknowledging and helping customers.
Works hard for customers, your team and your department.

Adaptable and resilient to meet the ever changing demands of our business.
You must be able to follow instructions either verbal or written.
You are reliable and a good timekeeper.
You must be smart and tidy at all times.
Whats in it for you?
We offer excellent benefits that help make Tesco a great place to work. These include but aren't limited to:
Competitive Salary
Bonus Scheme*
Our Virtual GP service provides free and confidential access to an online GP through video GP consultations, and online prescription service for colleagues. The service is also available to families of colleagues who live at the same address for a reduced cost.
24/7 access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for you and family members for in the moment emotional support along with free access to a range of wellbeing services supporting you under our new Wellbeing First approach of Body, Mind and Life.
Colleague Clubcard offering 10% discount across stores and online, with 15% discount weekends once a month (Friday to Sunday), and 20% off twice a year. There is also 20% off F&F clothing, all year long, these various discounts can be extended to a family member with a 2nd Clubcard available.*
Life Assurance
Pension Plan*
Save As You Earn Scheme*
Paid Family Leave
Bike to Work
Long Service Awards
Commuter Scheme
*Entry requirements and rules of the scheme apply
About Us
Our vision at Tesco is to become every customer's favourite way to shop, whether they are at home or out on the move. Our core purpose is "Serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day". Serving means more than a transactional relationship with our customers. It means acting as a responsible and sustainable business for all stakeholders, for the communities we are part of, and for the planet. Through initiatives like the Tesco Community Fund, our association with Children's Health Foundation, our partnership with FoodCloud and our Stronger Starts programme, we have supported over 21,000 community groups, raised over €7.5 million for medical equipment, and provided almost 15 million meals nationwide, to those living in food insecurity.
Tesco has operated in the Irish retail market since 1997, and with 190+ stores nationwide, we employ over 13,000 people in cities and towns around Ireland, supporting almost 45,000 jobs directly and indirectly. We partner with over 500 Irish suppliers - of which almost three-quarters are small and medium enterprises - which in turn supports almost 13,000 farming families around Ireland. Tesco is the single largest buyer of Irish food and drink in the world, buying €1.6 Billion a year; more than any other single country in the European Union, more than even the USA which you perceive as a massive buyer of Irish food.
We work closely with suppliers across Ireland who are dedicated to making the best products for our customers and this is reflected in the numerous awards our products have won over the years including Blás Na hÉireann, World Steak Challenge and Great Taste Awards.
We are proud to have an inclusive culture at Tesco where everyone truly feels able to be themselves. It is embedded in our values: we treat people how they want to be treated. At Tesco, we not only celebrate diversity, but recognise the value and opportunity it brings. We always want our colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work and we are committed to helping them be at their best.
We know life looks a little different for each of us. That's why at Tesco, we always welcome chats about flexible working. Some people are at the start of their careers, some want the freedom to do the things they love. Others are going through life-changing moments like becoming a carer, nearing retirement, adapting to parenthood, or something else. So, talk to us throughout your application about how we can support.
Tesco is committed to celebrating diversity and everyone is welcome at Tesco. We're committed to providing a fully inclusive recruitment process, allowing candidates the opportunity to thrive and inform us of any reasonable adjustments they may require. For further information on the accessibility support we can offer, please click http://roi.tesco-careers.com/accessibility/

Please let us know you need additional support by emailing tescoireland.recruitment@tesco.ie

jobs.title: STA Design Engineer
jobs.desc:
We are looking for an experienced
Static Timing Analysis (STA) Engineer
to join a world-leading semiconductor company developing next-generation, high-performance, low-power SoCs. You'll play a key role in timing signoff, timing closure and methodology development, working closely with cross-functional engineering teams to deliver cutting-edge silicon.
As an STA Engineer, you will be responsible for performing static timing analysis, developing and validating timing constraints, and driving timing closure across complex ASICs and SoCs. Working with RTL, Synthesis and Physical Design teams, you'll help optimise performance, power and area while ensuring designs meet timing signoff requirements.
Responsibilities
Perform static timing analysis and timing closure for complex cores and full-chip SoCs.
Develop and improve STA methodologies, flows and timing signoff processes.
Drive timing accuracy while improving static and dynamic analysis turnaround times.
Ensure designs meet timing signoff criteria and project quality standards.
Develop automation for timing and power data collection, processing and analysis.
Support project planning by contributing to technical milestones and deliverables.
Deliver project objectives on schedule while providing production support when required.
Troubleshoot and resolve timing-related issues throughout the development lifecycle.
Requirements
Experience using STA tools such as PrimeTime, PrimeShield or Tempus for hierarchical timing analysis on large SoCs.
Hands-on experience with timing ECO tools including Tweaker, PrimeClosure, PTECO or Tempus ECO.
Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, Tcl and/or Perl.
Solid understanding of the ASIC implementation flow from RTL through to GDS.
Knowledge of Design for Parametric Yield would be beneficial.
Experience with extraction and circuit simulation tools is advantageous.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a practical, results-focused approach.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary engineering teams.
4+ years' experience in Static Timing Analysis or a closely related field.
By applying to this role you understand that we may collect your personal data and store and process it on our systems. For more information please see our Privacy Notice https://eu-recruit.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/European-Tech-Recruit-Privacy-Notice-2024.pdf

The FP&A Analyst will support financial planning, performance analysis and management reporting across Perigus Energy’s renewable energy portfolio. jobs.title: Graduate Mobile Software Engineer (Android/iOS)
jobs.desc:
Role Overview
Location: Cork (Hybrid)
We’re hiring Graduate Mobile Software Engineers to join NETGEAR’s Mobile Engineering team in Cork. You’ll help build the next generation of native mobile apps that connect millions of customers to their NETGEAR devices.
You’ll work alongside experienced mobile engineers across the full product life cycle, from requirements through build and test to release and the production data that follows. You’ll write production code in your first weeks, not your first year, and you’ll use AI coding agents as a standard part of your toolkit.
Engineers here own their work end to end, including quality. That ownership is the fastest way to earn trust and take on bigger work.
You’ll join our mobile engineering team in Cork, which is part of NETGEAR’s global engineering organization. The team is hybrid, and you’ll spend at least two days a week in the office to collaborate, learn and share ideas.
What You Will Be Doing
Building features in our native Android (Kotlin) and iOS (Swift) applications, from ticket to release.
Owning the quality of what you build, including functional QA, regression testing and release validation.
Testing on real devices to make sure setup flows, error states and edge cases work for the person holding the phone, not just for the test suite.
Writing and maintaining automated unit, integration and UI tests, so the same bug is never found twice by hand.
Working AI-first, using agentic coding tools to plan, write, test, review and refactor, and helping the team get better at it.
Automating repetitive work by contributing to CI/CD pipelines, build tooling and release automation.
Debugging and optimizing using crash, performance and analytics data from production.
Integrating APIs, SDKs and cloud services to power app functionality.
Taking part in agile ceremonies and code reviews, giving and receiving feedback.
Doing what the release needs, whether that is a test pass, a build fix, a script or a spec.
What You Will Gain
Hands-on experience building and shipping native Android and iOS apps used by millions of customers worldwide.
Real ownership of quality, which is the fastest route to trust and scope on this team.
A deep understanding of mobile architectures, UI frameworks and platform APIs.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and modern DevOps practice.
Fluency in AI-assisted development using Claude Code, Copilot and ChatGPT.
A structured graduate onboarding path with a named mentor and a defined first-year development plan.
Room to grow within NETGEAR’s global engineering organization.
What We Are Looking For
A Level 8 honours degree (or an equivalent honours bachelor’s degree) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronic Engineering or a related discipline.
Real evidence that you can code, in any language. College projects, internships, personal apps, open source and hackathons all count.
An eye for quality. You notice when something feels wrong for the user, not just when a test fails.
Curiosity about AI-assisted development and a willingness to work in a toolchain that is changing quickly.
A hands-on attitude. Our best engineers pick up whatever the release needs rather than waiting for it to be assigned.
Clear written and spoken communication.
Strong problem solving, attention to detail and a collaborative mindset.
Nice to Have
Native mobile experience, Kotlin and Jetpack Compose on Android, or Swift and SwiftUI on iOS.
Any published app, even a small one.
Experience with cross-platform frameworks such as React Native or Flutter.
Exposure to Git, CI/CD or automated testing.
Knowledge of REST APIs and mobile architecture fundamentals such as MVC or MVVM.
Interest in networked applications, IoT or connected devices.
We assess aptitude, not a checklist. If you have shipped something you are proud of in any stack, apply. With several roles available, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box.
Why Join NETGEAR
Build mobile apps that help millions of users manage and connect their devices worldwide.
Start your career alongside a Cork-based team that values innovation, craftsmanship and continuous learning.
Work on mobile and IoT technology at global scale.
Learn and deliver faster with leading AI development tools.
Competitive salary, pension, healthcare and share scheme.
Key Details
Start date: November 2026
Closing date: 1st November 2026.
Eligibility to live and work in Ireland is required. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for these roles.
Company Statement/Values
At NETGEAR, we are on a mission to unleash the full potential of connectivity with intelligent solutions that delight and protect. We turn ideas into innovative networking products that connect people, power businesses, and advance the way we live.
We're a performance-driven, talented and connected team that's committed to delivering world-class products for our customers. As a company, we value our employees as the most essential building blocks of our success. And as teammates, we commit to taking our work to the
Next Gear
by living our values: we
Dare to Transform
the future,
Connect and Delight
our customers,
Communicate Courageously
with each other and collaborate to
Win It Together
. You’ll find our values woven through our processes, present in our decisions, and celebrated throughout our culture.
We strive to attract top talent and create a great workplace where people feel engaged, inspired, challenged, proud and respected. If you are creative, forward-thinking, passionate about technology and are looking for a rewarding career to make an impact, then you've got what it takes to succeed at NETGEAR. Join our network and help us shape the future of connectivity.
NETGEAR hires based on merit. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.desc:
Mechanical Design Engineer
(Machine Design)
About Your New Employer
Join an established specialist engineering business designing and manufacturing capital equipment for the pharmaceutical industry.
Work alongside a highly skilled mechanical design team on complex, technically challenging equipment used within the life sciences sector.
Develop your career in a collaborative engineering environment focused on quality, innovation and technical excellence.
Your new employer specialises in the design and manufacture of specialist pharmaceutical equipment. The business works on complex engineering projects where precision, quality and compliance with industry standards are essential.
About Your New Job
As a Mechanical Design Engineer, you will translate client requirements into production-ready mechanical designs for the fabrication of pharmaceutical equipment.
You will:
Design and draft mechanical equipment using 3D and 2D CAD, primarily in Solid Edge, SolidWorks or Autodesk Inventor.
Review client User Requirement Specifications and develop concepts, detailed designs, general arrangements, manufacturing drawings, parts lists and assembly documentation.
Work as part of a project core team to deliver projects within agreed schedules and budgeted hours.
Act as the mechanical design Subject Matter Expert throughout the project lifecycle, supporting fabrication and assembly teams with technical and manufacturability queries.
Lead Stage-Gate design reviews and manage the approval process for general arrangement drawings and P&IDs with clients.
Lead the development of ergonomic mock-up reviews.
Develop Bills of Materials, support supplier identification and liaise with procurement, ERP and PLM teams.
Support project scheduling, change management and the preparation of Variation Change Requests for client approval.
Support the preparation and execution of Factory Acceptance Testing and Site Acceptance Testing protocols.
What Skills You Need
A degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.
At least three years’ experience in the mechanical design of machines or specialist equipment.
Strong proficiency in 3D CAD, ideally Solid Edge. Experience with SolidWorks or Autodesk Inventor will also be considered.
Experience with sheet metal design and the generation of flat patterns.
Proven experience in concept design, detailed design and the production of manufacturing documentation.
A strong understanding of design for manufacture, fabrication and machining.
Experience working within the life sciences industry and knowledge of Good Documentation Practices.
Knowledge of ATEX, CE, UL and general machine safety standards.
Excellent communication, organisation and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
What's on Offer
A salary of
€45,000–€55,000, depending on experience
.
A permanent, full-time, office-based opportunity within the pharmaceutical engineering sector.
The opportunity to work on complex, high-value engineering projects.
A collaborative role with significant technical responsibility and exposure to clients, suppliers, production and project teams.

Alan Fitzpatrick

+353 21 4847136

As a Store Manager at Victoria’s Secret you’ll take ownership of the success of your store, inspiring your team to achieve their targets and create the very best customer experience everyday.

Lead from the heart - You’ll train, coach and inspire your team, setting them up for success and developing them to be stars of the future

Hands on operations - You’ll own your P&L and lead on key KPIs across the store, always with a focus on profitability and controllable costs (think hiring, rotas, payroll, customer success, stock control) which help maximise sales and profitability
An eye for visuals - our brand visual standards are high (of course), but with the support of our Visual Team you will be accomplished in their execution, and you’ll ensure your team are too
Open eyes and ears - Your vision and passion for our products will help the business grow and change for the better. Your feet on the ground - Your store is your specialty and to keep it up to date and safe you will keep it compliant. You’ll own product launches, floor set changes, store audits and stock counts, H&S policies, and make sure everything is in place to keep you and your team efficient and safe
About You
A wealth of experience -
With your previous store manager experience in a fast paced store(s) you can demonstrate a record of managing and exceeding sales targets and KPIs
You can demonstrate a strong understanding of how to lead and deliver a company strategy, with the ability to implement objectives in your store that drive strong performance and results

Creative flair - People describe you as approachable and resourceful with a creative side when it comes to engaging teams with training, local incentives and global initiatives

Victoria’s Secret UK & IRE is a joint venture between Victoria’s Secret & Co. and Next plc group uniting two global retail leaders to deliver iconic lingerie, seamless service, and standout brand storytelling across our stores and digital platforms.

So, apply today and help to shape the future of one of the world’s most iconic brands, where every colleague is empowered to feel confident, valued, and unapologetically themselves.

Being part of our iconic world isn’t the only thing we have on offer, you’ll also have access to:
Set flexible working schedules to suit both the business and your lifestyle
25% off a wide selection of styles at Victoria's Secret, Next, Gap in-store
Exclusive offers from over 3,500 retailers through Reward Gateway
Incentives and competitions with amazing prizes that run all year round
Access to free financial, health, and wellbeing services, including 24/7 digital GP
Learning and development opportunities, as well as on-the-job training
Core benefits such as pension contributions and life assurance
Conditions apply to all benefits. These benefits are discretionary and subject to change.

Should you need support with your application due to a disability or long-term condition, feel free to get in touch with us by email UKHR@victoriassecret.co.uk(please include 'Workplace Adjustments' in the subject line)

jobs.title: Head of Integrated Marketing
jobs.desc:
Description
Teamwork.com is an agentic PSA (professional services automation) platform that helps businesses win, plan and deliver projects more profitably. We connect projects, resourcing and financials in one place, so leaders get real numbers from real delivery, not guesswork, and can price work on purpose, deliver it for less, and grow margin over time. Our tagline puts it plainly: most tools track work, we make it profitable.
Project management tools can't manage money, so run delivery through one and you lose margin without ever seeing where. Finance-first tools capture the numbers, but delivery teams resist using them, so the data going in is bad and the numbers coming out are worse. Teamwork.com is built to do both: resourcing, financials and margin visibility captured as delivery happens, not bolted on afterwards, in a platform teams actually want to use.
We believe in hiring great people and look to ensure everyone has the best possible experience of work, every day. We strive to be open and transparent, humble and customer focused. And we thrive on curiosity, getting results and working together relentlessly to deliver excellence. We are a company of action, full of triers and doers: we try things, we make mistakes, and we learn from them.

jobs.desc:
Role Overview
This is a hybrid role based in our Cork office.
As a Staff Engineer on NETGEAR’s AI Platform and Enablement team, you will play a strategic and highly impactful role in shaping how AI is built into the fabric of the whole company: engineering teams, business units and corporate functions alike. This position is designed for a deeply experienced technical leader who thrives at the intersection of AI infrastructure, developer enablement and business enablement.
You will own three interconnected areas of ownership. First, you will help build and operate the core AI and LLM platform: model routing, evaluation, and the shared tooling that lets teams across NETGEAR build reliably on top of large language models. Second, you will scale the use of coding agents and assistants across engineering, raising AI fluency and the bar on how we ship software. Third, and equally important, you will extend AI enablement beyond engineering and into business functions — finding the workflows worth automating and building them.
That third mandate is not a side project. A meaningful share of NETGEAR’s near-term AI value sits in business process, not product code, and this role is expected to have organisation-wide impact. Much of the work will resemble the enablement currently being driven for non-technical teams, scaled up and made repeatable.
With significant autonomy, you will own delivery of key technical initiatives aligned with organisational goals and directly influence the short and medium-term success of NETGEAR’s AI strategy.
Key Responsibilities
AI and LLM Platform Infrastructure
Design, build, and operate the shared AI platform layer: model routing and fallback strategies, API gateway patterns, rate limiting, and multi-provider abstraction (Anthropic, OpenAI, and others as needed).
Own cost and usage optimisation across the organisation’s AI spend, covering model selection, prompt and context efficiency, caching, and session-level cost controls.
Build evaluation, observability, and monitoring for LLM-powered features and agents, including quality regression detection and usage analytics.
Define architecture and standards for secure, scalable integration of AI capabilities into product and internal systems, including authentication, data handling, and compliance considerations.
Engineering AI Enablement
Drive adoption and effective use of AI coding agents and assistants (for example Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) across engineering teams.
Build internal tooling, guardrails, and workflows (agentic SDLC patterns, managed agents, review and QA processes) that let engineers safely delegate more work to AI.
Establish best practices, documentation, and training that raise the AI fluency of the wider engineering organisation.
Business and Functional Enablement
Partner directly with business units and corporate functions (Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Marketing, Sales, People, Legal) to identify high-value AI opportunities in their day-to-day work.
Sit with functional teams, map how their processes actually run today, and simplify before automating: strip out steps that exist only for historical reasons rather than encoding them into an agent.
Design and deliver AI solutions for non-technical users, including skills, agents, connectors and internal applications that people without an engineering background can adopt and trust.
Build the enablement layer that makes this repeatable: reusable patterns, templates, onboarding material, office hours, and a community of practice across functions.
Translate fluently in both directions - turning business problems into technical designs and explaining technical constraints and risks in language a functional leader can act on.
Technical Leadership and Collaboration
Reporting directly to the AI Platform Engineering Director, working with cross-functional teams to align technical execution with NETGEAR’s AI strategy.
Own delivery of end-to-end initiatives that bridge platform infrastructure, developer tooling, business process and product engineering.
Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, and system debugging across multiple layers of the platform.
Provide mentorship and guidance to engineers and functional champions working with AI tools and platform services, nurturing a culture of technical excellence and responsible AI use.
Establish and track clear objectives, delivering measurable results aligned with quarterly goals and reporting on AI-driven productivity gains and cost efficiency across the organisation.
Required Qualifications
8+ years of software engineering experience, with a demonstrated history of leading impactful technical initiatives.
Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar) in production, including prompt and context design, tool use, and agentic workflows.
Demonstrated ability to simplify complexity: taking a tangled business flow or legacy process, understanding it end to end, and reducing it to something clear, reliable and automatable. A track record of continuously exploring new tools and techniques in a fast-moving field.
Experience working directly with non-technical stakeholders to deliver technology that they adopt and keep using.
Strong track record of cost, performance, and reliability optimisation in cloud or distributed systems, with a proven ability to influence business outcomes through technology decisions.
Experience building or operating internal developer platforms, APIs, or shared infrastructure used by multiple teams.
Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools and a genuine interest in scaling their use across an organisation.
Strong design and architectural skills, including experience with distributed systems, observability, and secure API design.
Proficiency in one or more of: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or similar languages used for platform and tooling development.
Demonstrated experience defining and delivering on a platform or enablement strategy, not just individual features.
Strong communicator, able to articulate technical direction to both technical and non-technical audiences and comfortable presenting to functional leadership.
Experience with agent frameworks, MCP (Model Context Protocol), or similar tool-orchestration approaches.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent hands-on experience.
Preferred Qualifications
Background in business process automation, RPA, workflow tooling or systems integration across enterprise applications (for example ERP, CRM, finance or supply chain systems).
Expertise with CI/CD, DevOps practices, and automation (for example GitHub Actions) applied to AI and ML workflows.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and cloud-native architectures.
Background in data or ML engineering, evaluation frameworks, or LLMOps.
Experience working across mobile, web, or embedded systems and understanding how AI integrates with each.

jobs.desc:
Do you take pride in creating great experiences for others and enjoy working in an environment where no two days are the same. We’re on the lookout for enthusiastic, friendly, and celebration-loving people to join our team as Sales Assistants.
Our stores are places of celebration, creativity, and connection—every day of the year. As things get busier, we’re looking for extra hands and friendly faces to help keep everything running smoothly. If you enjoy being part of a vibrant, welcoming environment, we’d love to have you on the team.
What You’ll Be Getting Up To:
Put our customers at the heart of everything you do — it’s our promise to them.
Make every shopper feel welcomed, wowed, and won over — that’s the cardfactory way!
Serve at the tills with a smile, making sure everyone finds what they came in for (and maybe a little extra).
Keeping our shelves stocked and looking fabulous.
Recommend our amazing range of gifts, wrap, and more — we’re so much more than cards!
No retail experience needed, you’ll be working with a friendly team and receive full training. What matters most is that you’re friendly, approachable, comfortable on your feet (it gets busy, but it’s all part of the fun!) and ready to help. If you’re flexible with your time — we may even offer shifts across nearby stores if you’re up for.
If you’ve got great communication skills, love to chat, whilst gaining valuable experience in a fun and friendly environment, this could be the perfect opportunity for you. At cardfactory, you’ll be part of a supportive team, learning new skills and helping to create memorable moments for every customer who walks through our doors.
Our colleagues tell us — it’s a great team, good vibes, flexible hours and a job they genuinely love. If you’re ready to be a celebration expert, we’d love to hear from you.
There’s no fixed closing date for this role, so we encourage you to apply early as we may close the vacancy once we’ve received enough applications.
No agencies, please.

jobs.title: Chanel, Beauty Consultant, Seasonal
jobs.desc:
GET TO KNOW US
CHANEL is an independent company that believes in the freedom of creation, cultivates human potential, and acts to have a positive impact in the world
“In order to be irreplaceable, one must always be different” stated company founder, Gabrielle Chanel. At CHANEL, we strive to identify what is unique in each person and support them through their journey with the brand
Our mission at CHANEL Beauty is to underline what is most unique in every person and give our clients the confidence to become the true expression of themselves through exceptional fragrance, makeup and skincare creations
KNOW THE ROLE
As a Seasonal Beauty Advisor, you are the ultimate CHANEL ambassador and you will play a key role in our mission, embodying our values and DNA in line with supporting our teams instore at the busiest time of the retail year
Key Responsibilities
Demonstrate your passion and knowledge in Fragrance, Makeup and Skincare
Create a unique and personalised experience for our clients which is authentic and tailored to their personal needs
Ensure excellence in client service in accordance with CHANEL’s standards
Be part of a collaborative and inclusive community for the Holiday season to achieve individual and collective goals
Know What We're Looking For
Service oriented approach: The ability to provide an outstanding level of Client experience and service
Confidence: you have the ability to apply product expertise to client’s needs in genuine and personalised way
Empathy and active listening: you understand and adapt the selling ceremony to the client’s needs
Passion: you show enthusiasm for Fragrance & Beauty products, services, and you are able to demonstrate it to the customer, managers and team members
Problem solving attitude: you can overcome obstacles, objections with positive attitude
Fostering meaningful client experience
Working in a highly collaborative and fast-paced environment
Know How We Work
Experience is our business:
Our customer engagement sets the bar in service and experiential retail, giving our customers something to love every time.
We Are More Than Shops:
We create enjoyable places, to excite, where people socialise, discover, learn and are inspired, and where local communities are enriched.
We are Curators:
Our unique range of product and services are key to the sense of excitement that Brown Thomas Arnotts is renowned for, whether for a special day or every day, things that make our customer’s lives better.
We Care for Our People
: We believe a great customer experience starts with a great people experience. That is why we promote a culture where talent is nurtured and where creativity and learning are valued.

jobs.title: Project Manager (Automation)
jobs.desc:
Department:
AI & Automation, Musgrave Group
Reports to:
Head of AI & Automation
Contract:
Fixed-term contract
Location:
Cork office, operating under Musgrave's Work Smart hybrid working model
Travel:
Travel to Musgrave and project sites across Ireland is required, depending on project activity
Join Musgrave: Where Innovation Meets Heritage, and People Drive Change
Musgrave is one of Europe’s most successful family-owned businesses, with a rich 150-year legacy in food and brand innovation. We`re proud to serve communities across Ireland and Spain, feeding one in three people every day through iconic brands like SuperValu, Centra, Mace, Frank and Honest, and Musgrave MarketPlace. By supporting thousands of retail and foodservice family businesses, we make a positive impact on the communities they serve. We`re committed to becoming the most trusted and sustainable business in Ireland, and we`re looking for dynamic, forward-thinking individuals to join us on this journey.
As we continue our journey toward becoming Ireland’s most trusted and sustainable business, we have an exciting opportunity for a successful candidate to join our team as a
Project Manager (Automation).
This is a hands-on delivery role combining project management and Scrum Master responsibilities. The successful candidate will lead the day-to-day delivery of assigned automation and intelligent automation initiatives, run Agile ceremonies, coordinate business and technical stakeholders, and maintain clear focus on business case outcomes and benefits.
You will act as the key link between business stakeholders, Business Analysts and AI & Automation delivery teams, ensuring that work is clearly planned, prioritised, tracked and delivered. You will work within the AI & Automation Factory operating model and the governance frameworks and delivery standards defined at programme level.
Please note that this is a 12 month contract
What You’ll Be Doing
Project and Agile Delivery
Lead the day-to-day delivery of assigned automation and intelligent automation projects, typically through short delivery cycles and small cross-functional teams.
Plan and coordinate delivery from project initiation through implementation, adoption and transition into support.
Act as Scrum Master for assigned initiatives, facilitating sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, reviews and retrospectives.
Work with Business Analysts, technical teams and business owners to maintain clear priorities, delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues and actions.
Identify and help remove delivery blockers, escalating matters through the appropriate programme-level channels where required.
Use Agile methodology pragmatically, adapting delivery practices to the needs, scale and maturity of each initiative.
Stakeholder Engagement and Coordination
Build trusted working relationships with business leaders, operational teams, process owners and technical delivery colleagues.
Coordinate stakeholder engagement throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring clear communication, aligned expectations and timely decisions.
Act as the primary day-to-day point of coordination between business stakeholders, Business Analysts and delivery teams.
Facilitate workshops, planning sessions, project meetings and other collaborative activities.
Communicate delivery status, emerging risks, dependencies and decisions clearly to stakeholders and programme leadership.
Business Case Delivery and Benefits Tracking
Keep project delivery aligned with the agreed business case, scope and intended outcomes.
Work with business owners and Business Analysts to define measurable benefits and maintain appropriate benefit-tracking arrangements.
Monitor progress towards expected outcomes and support post-implementation reviews and benefits reporting.
Escalate material changes that may affect scope, timescales, delivery feasibility or expected benefits.
Delivery Governance and Reporting
Operate within the governance frameworks, delivery standards and decision-making structures established at programme level.
Maintain accurate project plans, delivery updates, risks, issues, dependencies, actions and decisions.
Provide clear, timely project-level information to support programme reporting and governance forums.
Use Azure DevOps, Jira or agreed delivery tools to support backlog management, sprint planning, delivery tracking and reporting.
Support clear and accessible project documentation in Confluence or other agreed collaboration tools.
Adoption and Continuous Improvement
Coordinate with business owners and relevant change or adoption colleagues to support readiness, implementation and adoption.
Capture lessons learned and use retrospectives to improve team ways of working and delivery effectiveness.
Where relevant, apply continuous improvement principles to support practical process and delivery improvements.
What We’re Looking For
Exceptional stakeholder engagement, facilitation and coordination skills, with the ability to build trust and maintain alignment across business and technical teams.
Strong project delivery capability, with practical experience managing plans, priorities, risks, issues, dependencies and actions.
Experience running Agile ceremonies and supporting teams to deliver through iterative delivery cycles.
Good technical awareness and the ability to engage confidently with both business stakeholders and technical specialists.
A practical understanding of AI, automation and digital technologies; direct platform expertise is beneficial but not essential.
Strong organisational, communication and problem-solving skills.
Adaptable, collaborative and focused on achieving measurable business outcomes.
Experience And Requirements
Approximately five years’ relevant experience delivering technology, automation, digital, process improvement or business change projects.
Experience operating as a Project Manager, Scrum Master or in a blended project delivery role.
Project Management and/or Scrum Master certification, such as PRINCE2, PMP, APM, CSM or PSM, is preferred.
Practical experience using Azure DevOps, Jira or similar Agile delivery tools for backlog management, sprint planning, delivery tracking and reporting is preferred.
Experience working with Business Analysts, technical delivery teams and business stakeholders.
Experience supporting business case delivery and tracking expected benefits.
Understanding of Agile delivery principles and the ability to apply them pragmatically.
Due to the requirement to travel to Musgrave and project sites across Ireland, a full driving licence and access to suitable transport for business travel are required.
Desirable Experience
Experience delivering Robotic Process Automation, Intelligent Automation, AI or other digital technology initiatives.
Familiarity with automation platforms such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Blue Prism or Microsoft Power Platform.
Familiarity with workflow automation, intelligent document processing or process mining.
Experience applying continuous improvement, Lean or process-improvement approaches.
Experience using Confluence or similar collaboration tools to support documentation and delivery transparency.
Success in Role
Success in this role will be measured through effective and predictable project delivery, strong stakeholder engagement, productive Agile team practices, successful business adoption, delivery against agreed business cases and the tracking and realisation of measurable benefits.

Career Development:
With a commitment to your personal and professional growth, Musgrave offers numerous opportunities for advancement and learning.
Collaborative Environment
: Work alongside a passionate team, where your contributions will make a significant impact.
Innovation Focus:
Be part of a company that values forward-thinking solutions.
Community Focus:
