jobs.title: Commercial & Operations Associate,
jobs.desc:
Eurofins Scientific
is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.
Job Description
To support the delivery of revenue targets and the organisation's business development and operational activities. The role delivers against defined KPIS to support consistent, profitable and sustainable growth across targeted service lines for the Environment Testing business in Ireland. The Commercial & Operations Associate develops and sustain relationships with new and existing customers and key stakeholders, identifies business development opportunities, and supports the full sales cycle from lead generation, tendering and contract award through to operational handover and service delivery. The role also provides account management for newly won work and a selected portfolio of existing customers, while assisting with the planning and scheduling of driver jobs in synchro teams.
REPORTING TO Commercial & Operations Manager
Main Commercial responsibilities Will include:
Identify leads and develop prospects to generate a project pipeline of sufficient value to achieve and sustain growth  objectives.
Maintain pipeline updates and records on a weekly basis and assist with preparation of weekly commercial reports.
Manage a selected portfolio of existing customer accounts, maintaining regular contact, supporting issue resolution and identifying opportunities to improve service delivery and develop the account.
Work with Group Marketing to develop materials and tools that support business development and promote the Eurofins brand.
Resolve or escalate commercial issues and negotiations, with support from functional leads where required.
Support tender processes by conducting quality reviews to understand logistics, operational and technical requirements, incorporating feedback from functional leads and developing high-quality proposals that meet the required service and quality standards.
Conduct market research and competitor analysis.
Manage Customer queries, complaints and escalation processes.
Main Operations responsibilities Will include:
Assist with the Planning and scheduling of jobs in Synchro teams for drivers, ensuring that available job information and customer requirements are accurately reflected to Support efficient service delivery.
Review scheduled routes to target new customers on selected routes.
Monitor customer satisfaction and service delivery for existing clients though monthly NPS.
Own the account management and mobilisation of newly won work from contract award through to stable operational delivery, acting as a clear point of contact for the customer and internal stakeholders.
Work with laboratory, logistics and operations teams to drive service improvements.
Ensure customer sampling requirements are translated into operational plans.
Assist with contingency planning for resource shortages, holidays and peak workloads.
Qualifications
EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE
What we are looking for:
Previous experience working within an accredited contract testing laboratory or related industry laboratory environment preferred.
Previous customer facing experience preferred.
Who we are looking for:
Hard-working, self-motivated and professional team player.
Confident and effective communicator and relationship builder.
Ability to work well under pressure.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to multitask, prioritise, organise and co-ordinate your own workload.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Microsoft office experience is an advantage
Additional Information
What can we offer you?
Fixed term contract;
Flexible working hours;
A dynamic team with flat hierarchies and opportunities for active participation;
Personal and professional development opportunities, as well as exclusive benefits for Eurofins employees;
We support your development!
Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.
We embrace diversity!
Eurofins network of companies believe in strength and innovation through diversity, being an
Equal Opportunity Employer
. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.
Sustainability matters to us!
We are well on our way to achieving our objective of carbon neutrality by 2025, through a combination of emission reduction and compensation initiatives. We encourage our laboratory leaders to make sustainable changes at their local level, and in addition to their initiatives we also count on our dedicated carbon reduction team to help us to achieve this goal!
Find out more in our career page: https://careers.eurofins.com/
Company description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.
The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.
In over 35 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to ca. 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of 950 laboratories in 60 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.
In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.9 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

jobs.title: Technical Director/Manager
jobs.desc:
Do you have what it takes to transform society?
Do you enjoy being part of a dynamic and inclusive team where respect for people is a priority? Then Sweco is the place to be!
We are currently looking for a talented and motivated
Technical Director/Manager
to join our Transportation team in Ireland, based in our office in Cork city centre. At Sweco we recognise the importance of work life balance and offer colleagues hybrid working and flexible working.
Our transport engineering teams are recognised industry leaders and operate across several markets including the strategic road network, local roads and private developments through a series of investment programmes, professional service frameworks and bespoke project commissions. We work for a wide range of clients including national government agencies, local authorities, private developers and contractors. We use the latest design software and techniques to produce innovative, efficient and sustainable design solutions for our clients.
What does the role involve?
Responsibilities
You will play a leading role in the delivery of roads, active travel and public transport projects within multidisciplinary design teams by working closely with our clients to understand their needs and ensuring they are met. You will be responsible for:
Identifying opportunities, running tenders, winning work, co-ordinating discussions with the bid executive, bid team and legal team to ensure that adequate provisions are included in all bids to manage and mitigate all risks.
Ensuring consistency of design approach and deliverable outputs within the project portfolio.
Supporting the technical and professional development of colleagues.
Undertaking a leading role in developing and maintaining our relationships with key clients and partners through active client engagement and building strong relationships through excellent delivery and expert knowledge.
Liaising and co-ordinating with colleagues to drive a consistent and thorough approach to managing work pipelines across the business unit and division and collaborating across the business.
The monitoring and reporting of the project’s financial performance.
Identifying risks and opportunities.
Liaising with clients, regulators and stakeholders to ensure the successful delivery of project deliverables.
Managing and mentoring colleagues.
To be successful in this role you’ll possess
Chartered membership of a relevant professional institution.
The ability to work across multi-discipline environments within Sweco business areas and generate business from leads.
Good client understanding of projects across the division with great sales and presentation skills.
The ability to influence strategic decision-making within the business and make commercial decisions within defined parameters (delivers to agreed project scope, time, cost and quality).
Excellent consultancy, communication and relationship management skills with experience of conducting workshops and giving presentations.
The ability to engage with key stakeholders to gain commitment and to influence the acceptance of new ideas and concepts in respect of change plans.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to adapt your style to suit different audiences.
Strong leadership skills to enable you to be a pro-active part of the business unit management team working alongside and providing support to the wider team in the development of overall objectives.
Extensive experience of relevant tender processes with the ability to understand the brief and demonstrate our professional capability.
Experience in delivering projects for a range of clients (contractors, local authorities, combined authorities, private developers).
Excellent time management and problem-solving skills with the ability to develop solutions.
If you believe you have the skill set required, are keen to join a business with genuine opportunities for career progression, then we’d love to hear from you.
Let’s transform society together at Sweco!
Employee Benefits
Flexible and hybrid working (Flexworks Policy)
Competitive pension contribution
Life Assurance
Allowance towards Permanent Health Insurance
Company car or car allowance
Discretionary Annual Bonus Scheme
Payment of two relevant professional subscriptions
25 days holiday plus bank holidays (with the option to purchase up to 5 additional days per year)
Cycle2Work Scheme
Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, financial and work advice)
Employee discounts via Sweco Benefit Select (Faircare)
We plant a tree for all new starters!
About Us
Transforming society together, we're planning and designing sustainable communities and cities of the future.
Solving the great societal challenges of our time is more relevant, demanding and inspiring than ever before. At Sweco, we bring together experts with different perspectives and skills to develop solutions that address the challenges of urbanisation, harness the positive power of digitalisation and make societies more sustainable.
We offer our clients a combination of global expertise and local presence, adapted to their business and reality. Our ambition is to be our clients’ most relevant partner, working together to help them solve their challenges, today and into the future.
Sweco is committed to enabling all its colleagues to achieve a great balance between work and their other priorities, such as caring responsibilities, leisure activities, further learning or other interests. We offer flexible start and finish times, part time and hybrid working options so that you can flex your hours around your day to day needs.
Equality, Diversity & Inclusion
It’s important to us that that all our colleagues thrive at work - we strive to have a friendly and inclusive culture which respects the contribution individuals can bring to Sweco. We aim to promote equality, inclusivity and diversity for everyone.
Here at Sweco we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy or maternity/paternity.
We have signed the Armed Forces Covenant to ensure those who serve or have served, and their families, are treated fairly. To find out more

You see the world through a unique lens and that’s exactly what we need. We embrace how you see things differently – it’s essential for creating a sustainable future.
Arup is a global consultancy with advisory and technical expertise across more than 150 disciplines. We guide, plan and design the future of the built environment. Globally, each year we recruit hundreds of graduates and students who help us see things differently and solve the most complex challenges facing our clients, climate and communities.

As a Procurement Advisory work placement student at Arup, you will:
Assist senior team members in delivering construction projects dealing with payment certificates and claims.
Assist senior team members in the preparation of bills of quantities, ensuring compliance with required method of measurement.
Be proactive in communicating and working with the direct team as well as Arup colleagues from various disciplines for the successful delivery of tasks.
Follow instructions and/or use own initiative to achieve designated tasks in a timely manner.
Understand the required outputs/deliverables of a project or assignment and work efficiently to deliver them.
Develop relationships with colleagues, always being professional, presentable and articulate.
Adopt a flexible approach to working, supporting multiple teams across the buildings and infrastructure sectors

Proactive, motivated and enthusiastic. Able to apply their own initiative to undertake tasks independently.
A team player, who can adopt flexible working practices to support the needs of the business.
Articulate, with both excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Logical in their approach to tasks, with the ability to interpret, understand and analyse data.
Output focused, always working with the objective in mind.
Commercially astute with strong numerical skills, demonstrating an attention to detail.
Proficient with Microsoft Office products and ideally Cost X (Although not necessary).

Changemakers: A passion for sustainable development and creating a better world is key.
Innovative minds: We’re looking for critical thinkers who embrace new ideas and challenge the status quo.
Growth seekers: You have a growth mindset, always eager to learn and explore new ways of working.
Adaptable adventurers: You’re ready to take on any challenge that comes your way.

16 October 2026

jobs.title: Seasonal Operator - Charleville
jobs.desc:
We are currently recruiting for a
Seasonal Operator
at our Kinisla site in Charleville, Co. Cork.
This is a full-time, seasonal position, with rotating day (08:00-16:00), evening (16:00-00:00), and night (00:00-8:00) shifts. During periods of increased demand, opportunities for overtime and weekend work will be available with increased pay rate. The season lasts from mid-January to November.
As a Seasonal Operator, you'll play a key role in our operations, with the chance to work in different areas of our site depending on your skills and training. Any previous experience as a production operative, warehouse operative, forklift operative, line operative or machine operator will be an advantage.
What will I be doing?
Working as part of a team in production areas, ensuring smooth and efficient manufacturing processes
Operating machinery and equipment safely and effectively
Adhering to health and safety guidelines
Assisting with quality control checks on ingredients and finished products
Supporting continuous improvement initiatives
Maintaining accurate production records
What do I need to be successful?
You will be a dependable team player who is motivated by the ability to add value and by championing collaboration and teamwork
You will show great attention to detail, helping to maintain efficient production processes and high-quality standards
You will have great communication skills, demonstrate fluency in English, and show motivation to learn
Experience in food manufacturing environment will be an advantage
What will I get in return?
At Kinisla, we believe in giving talented, curious people the opportunity to make a difference. We work as a team, searching for the best ways to inspire food and nourish life. We are a community of innovators, working across disciplines to solve global food challenges with a fresh approach. We want you to achieve whatever you put your mind to.
We also offer:
Career development opportunities
Employee benefit platform with discounts and offers for retailers online and offline, travelling, utilities and more
Matched pension scheme up to 10%
Employee Assistance Program, supporting your emotional, physical, nutritional and financial wellbeing
MyCommunity, have one day per year to volunteer for a worthwhile cause
Friendly team focused on continuous improvements and safety
About Kinisla
Kinisla is a vertically integrated farm-to-fork business with a very substantial consumer foods presence and a leading nutritional and dairy ingredients division, delivering high-quality dairy solutions with a focus on sustainability and innovation. From partnering with local family farms to producing world-class dairy products, we ensure every step of our value chain reflects our commitment to excellence.
With over 50 years' experience in milk processing, dairy and nutritional technology advancement, and product innovation, we are a key stakeholder in the global food industry and creators of a strong portfolio of market leading dairy brands including Cheestrings, Charleville and Coleraine Cheese, Dairygold, Golden Cow and our new SMUG range. Our from food, for food culture and deep-rooted connection to our 2,800 milk suppliers differentiates our business and offers captivating opportunities for our customers and consumers.
Our dairy comes from some of the world's richest grazing land and is produced by a network of Irish family farms that have one of the lowest carbon footprints in the world. Through a combination of expertise, innovation, and sustainability, Kinisla is proud to shape the future of dairy while meeting the diverse needs of our farmers, customers, and communities.
Headquartered in Tralee, Co. Kerry, we operate multiple manufacturing facilities in the southwest of Ireland, including Listowel, Charleville, Newmarket, and Farranfore. Additionally, we manage 29 Farm & Home stores throughout the region, ensuring comprehensive coverage and service. In Northern Ireland and the United Kingdom, our presence extends to key locations in Portadown, Coleraine, and Ossett.
Globally, Kinisla employs over 1,600 dedicated professionals across Ireland, Northern Ireland, the UK, USA, Netherlands, Spain, Germany, and China. In 2024, we achieved a turnover of approximately €1.3 billion, reflecting our commitment to excellence and growth.
Get in touch today!
In Kinisla we benefit from the knowledge of our colleagues who bring a diverse range of cultures, backgrounds, lifestyles and experiences. One team fostering an inclusive culture that, above all, inspires food and nourishes life. One culture where everyone brings their unique perspectives and experiences to help make us better, together. We are committed to nurturing an environment of positivity and inclusiveness, where everyone can be at their best, both personally and professionally.
Our recruitment, selection and assessment process are based on the skills and competencies of the specific roles and based entirely on merit. In addition, Kinisla does not currently utilise video chat rooms (e.g., Google Hangouts) to conduct interviews. Refuse any request that asks you to provide payment to participate in the hiring process (e.g., purchasing a "starter kit," investing in training, or something similar). Kinisla will not ask you to pay any money at any point in the hiring process with the exception of reimbursable travel expenses. In addition, any payments made by Kinisla will be from official firm accounts bearing the Kinisla name.

jobs.title: Calibration Technician
jobs.desc:
LotusWorks is an Engineering Services provider specializing in managing Commissioning, Construction Services, Calibration, Operations & Maintenance scopes of work within global manufacturing facilities. LotusWorks operates globally across EMEA and North America partnering with the world's leading manufacturers across the Semiconductor, Pharmaceutical & Biologics, Medical Device and Data Center sectors. Our team of Engineering and Technical professionals is immersed in cutting-edge technologies and innovations. LotusWorks is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, integral to our people-first approach.
As a Calibration Technician, you will report directly to the Site Lead and carry out planned and unplanned calibration activities in line with the calibration schedule prepared by the Lead Calibration Technician. The role will have a strong focus on process calibrations, while also supporting gauging calibrations as required. You will ensure that all Inspection, Measurement and Test Equipment (IMTE) is calibrated safely, on time, and in accordance with site quality requirements, with accurate completion of calibration records and timely escalation of any calibration issues. Safety is a line responsibility, and all personnel are responsible for ensuring that work is conducted safely within their direct or indirect supervision.
Responsibilities
Operations & Maintenance
Complete assigned calibration activities in accordance with the schedule prepared by the Lead Calibration Technician, escalating any risks to completion or equipment availability.
Perform process calibrations including pressure transmitters, transducers, manometers, ovens, furnaces, temperature controllers, freezers, pH and conductivity equipment, cleanrooms, cleanlines, refractometers, ultrasonic baths, packaging equipment and other process instrumentation.
Support gauging calibrations, including calipers, micrometers, pin, plug and thread gauges, drop gauges, overlay and TAPPI charts, CMM calibrations and air gauging systems.
Execute planned and reactive calibration activities in a safe, timely and compliant manner, minimizing disruption to production.
Promptly escalate calibration failures, technical issues and any risks to equipment availability.
Quality
Ensure calibration work orders, as-found/as-left results and associated records are completed accurately and on time within the calibration system and in accordance with site standards.
Follow approved procedures and Equipment Work Instructions (EWIs).
Escalate out-of-tolerance or failed calibrations in accordance with site procedures.
Support discrepancy investigations and ensure required actions are completed.
Complete all required training and maintain audit-ready calibration documentation.
Governance & Relationship Management
Report directly to the Site Lead and work to the operational priorities established through the Lead Calibration Technician.
Escalate schedule, quality, safety and technical issues as required.
Maintain strong working relationships with onsite equipment owners and users to coordinate calibration activities and ensure equipment readiness and access.
Collaborate with Quality, EHS, Engineering, Maintenance, Production and Metrology teams to support compliant calibration execution and troubleshooting.
Provide clear and timely updates on calibration progress, equipment failures, delays and required actions.
Resource Management
Manage assigned daily calibration activities efficiently and complete work within agreed priorities and due dates.
Support other Calibration Technicians and participate in cross-training to improve flexibility and coverage across process and gauging activities.
Maintain and develop technical competence in process instrumentation, calibration standards, troubleshooting and site calibration procedures.
Support Functions
Support the creation, review and continuous improvement of Equipment Work Instructions (EWIs), calibration procedures, Calibration Record Forms (CRFs) and Calibration Data Forms (CDFs), where required.
Adhere to all site Environmental, Health and Safety (EHS) requirements and the Life Without (LW) safety culture during all calibration activities.
Identify and support opportunities to improve calibration methods, workflow, equipment reliability, efficiency and compliance.
Any other duties or responsibilities that may be assigned to you in your role.
Skills Required
Practical experience in calibration, metrology, instrumentation or a related technical discipline.
Strong knowledge of process instrumentation and calibration principles.
Experience calibrating pressure, temperature, pH, conductivity and other process instrumentation.
Experience with gauging equipment and dimensional measurement techniques is desirable.
Ability to interpret technical procedures, Equipment Work Instructions (EWIs) and calibration documentation.
Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accurate documentation and data integrity.
Ability to identify, troubleshoot and escalate calibration failures and out-of-tolerance conditions.
Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple calibration activities and priorities.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with equipment owners and cross-functional teams.
Commitment to maintaining high standards of quality, safety and compliance.
Willingness to participate in cross-training and continued technical development.
Education / Licenses / Certifications
Minimum of Level 7 Qualification in Calibration/Engineering/Metrology or Process Instrumentation.
Proof of education, licenses, and certifications will be required where applicable
Benefits
VHI Healthcare Cover
Life Assurance
Pension Contribution
Training And Educational Assistance
Annual GP Check-Up
Extra Annual Leave
Healthcare Screening
Recognition Rewards
LotusWorks is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered.

jobs.title: Pre-Sales Solutions Architect – AI Agent & Workload Security
jobs.desc:
Tigera—the pioneer behind Calico and Lynx—is defining the future of AI agent security, workload governance, and cloud-native networking. As autonomous AI agents, LLM frameworks, and microservices proliferate across enterprise infrastructure, Tigera delivers the deep visibility, runtime protection, and eBPF-driven enforcement control required to secure the next generation of computing.
From modern cloud-native architectures to cutting-edge AI agent ecosystems, our technology safeguards over 1 million Kubernetes clusters across multicloud and hybrid environments. Trusted by world-class innovation leaders—including NVIDIA, Royal Bank of Canada, Bloomberg, Chipotle, GoDaddy, and Upwork—we empower enterprises to build, scale, and innovate with AI safely and without compromise.
At Tigera, our customers are the heroes of our story. We aim high, move fast, foster continuous learning, and build a high-trust, highly collaborative environment where every voice shapes the future of AI security. If you are looking to help make a substantial impact, and our values and products align with your vision of your career growth, we want to hear from you!
The Opportunity
AI agents are rapidly becoming the new runtime layer of the enterprise—and securing them is the next massive frontier in cybersecurity.
We are hiring a
Pre-Sales Solutions Architect
in
Cork, Ireland
, to serve as the technical champion for
Lynx
, our flagship solution designed specifically to secure autonomous AI agents and modern workloads. With customer demand skyrocketing and PoCs accelerating globally, you will be on the front lines of a brand-new product category.
You will partner closely with Account Executives, Product Management, and Marketing to guide prospective enterprises from initial architecture discussions through high-impact PoCs to closed-won deals. Additionally, you will work with our enterprise Calico accounts to unlock additional value by securing AI workloads.
This role is ideal for a forward-thinking pre-sales professional or platform/security engineer eager to spearhead AI agent security while the category is being defined. You don’t need to be an AI expert on day one—if you bring strong Kubernetes and application security foundations along with a passion for how AI systems are built, we will help you build the required expertise.
The role will be hybrid based out of our Cork city office.
You Will
Drive AI & Workload Security Deals: Lead the technical discovery, live demonstrations, solution architecture, and proof-of-concept (PoC) executions for Lynx across top-tier enterprise prospects.
Shape AI Security Requirements: Partner directly with prospects to discover how they build, deploy, and connect AI agents, and help them convert runtime patterns into concrete security and governance policies using Lynx.
Build Reusable Assets: Design and maintain state-of-the-art Lynx demo environments, PoC playbooks, and architecture blueprints to increase deal velocity.
Influence the Product Roadmap: Serve as the strategic feedback loop between the field and product engineering. Capture customer requirements, highlight market shifts, and directly influence the evolution of Lynx.
Champion the AI Security Movement: Represent Tigera as an author and speaker. Deliver technical webinars, lead workshops, participate in meetups/conferences, and publish insights on securing AI agents.
Master Technical Execution: Lead technical RFP/RFI responses, security questionnaire validations, and internal enablement sessions on AI agent security.
Guide Strategic Enterprise Accounts: Act as the trusted technical advisor for a dedicated set of Calico accounts. Drive platform adoption, conduct technical architecture reviews, and uncover expansion opportunities into Lynx.
Travel: Connect in person with enterprise clients and attend industry events across Europe (approx. 25% travel).
You Have
Pre-Sales or Hands-On Engineering Experience: 3 to 6 years in a customer-facing technical role (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Technical Consultant) OR hands-on experience in platform, DevOps, or cloud security engineering with a driven desire to launch a career in pre-sales.
Core Cloud-Native Foundations: Strong, hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerized architectures. You can comfortably stand up clusters, troubleshoot complex workloads, and explain core container runtime mechanics.
Security Discipline: Deep understanding of modern application and cloud security principles, including Zero Trust models, network policies, identity-based security, and cloud access controls.
Identity & Token Knowledge: Practical understanding of identity-first security—how JWTs are structured, signed, and validated; working knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and mTLS mechanics.
Cloud Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Sales Acumen: Sales skills such as active listening, MEDDPICC alignment and ability to translate features into business value.
Exceptional Communication: Natural ability to translate complex AI runtime mechanics and Zero Trust architectures into clear, compelling narratives for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.
Startup Mindset: Curious, self-driven, and excited by the opportunity to own and establish leadership in an emerging category.
Nice to Have (Bonus Points)
Hands-on exposure to building or securing AI/LLM applications or agents (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, or Model Context Protocol / MCP servers).
Familiarity with workload identity frameworks (e.g., SPIFFE/SPIRE) or API gateways / service meshes (Istio, Envoy).
Prior experience with Calico, Cilium, OpenShift, or eBPF technology.
Familiarity with emerging AI governance frameworks (EU AI Act, ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF).
Proficiency in a second European language.
Why Join Tigera?
Be at the Forefront of AI: Build your career at the intersection of eBPF, Kubernetes, and AI agent security.
Global Impact, Local Hub: Join a vibrant hub in Cork, Ireland, backed by global offices in San Francisco, San Jose, Vancouver, and London.
Comprehensive Compensation & Benefits: Highly competitive salary, sales incentive plans, and comprehensive health, vision, and dental coverage.
Culture of Growth & Autonomy: Work alongside industry experts who value openness, continuous learning, bold execution, and genuine team support.
With offices in San Francisco, San Jose, Vancouver (Canada), Cork (Ireland), and London (England), we have a thriving team of diverse individuals from all over the world. We believe in a collaborative, flexible work environment based on respect for, and commitment from, every employee. We also offer a competitive compensation package along with full health, vision, and dental benefits. These benefits, coupled with an amazing team of individuals who believe in our mission and value openness, collaboration, and teamwork, make Tigera an awesome place to work.

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. The Process Engineering department supports technical and scientific activities related to the manufacture of pharmaceutical products in AbbVie facilities or in contract facilities. The Director, through his/her section managers and direct reporting lines, will manage a technically diverse staff of highly specialized engineers and scientists. Develop and communicate cost estimates, business plans, timelines and contingency plans to accomplish project and departmental objectives within agreed time scope.
Participate in capital plan input and capital project execution to advance manufacturing capabilities
Make final decisions related to project responsibilities
Represent AbbVie during audits to regulatory agencies (US/ROW as appropriate) by supplying verbal or written information with active participation.
Responsible for ensuring that all members of the Engineering team follow all Company guidelines related to Health, Safety and Environmental practices and that all resources needed to do so are available and in good condition.
Provide leadership, coaching, training, and mentoring to direct reports. Negotiates, secures, oversees and ensures that all resources are available to meet the demands of the projects and site goals.

jobs.title: Applied AI Technology Specialist
jobs.desc:
Company Overview
Carbery Group is dedicated to enriching lives. How do we do this? Owned by the farmers of West Cork, we are a global business with deep local roots. Our mission is to deliver lasting value to our farmer shareholders while making positive impact on our customers, employees, suppliers, partners, and the communities we serve. We are committed to doing this by creating healthier, tastier, and more sustainable food and ingredient solutions.
With customers in over 50 countries, we pride ourselves on our commitment to innovation, our open mindset and ability to be a good partner. We prioritise our customers' needs, while also valuing our planet and fostering a thriving, people-first environment.
Your Role in Carbery's Success
As an Applied AI Technology Specialist, you will work closely with the group CIO to ensure that Carbery genuinely keeps current with how AI is evolving. You will bring deep, current knowledge of the AI landscape and test what is genuinely worth pursuing, while working alongside the senior team to help bring proven ideas into the business.
How You Will Contribute
Continuously track emerging AI models, tools, research and practitioner practice, and translate that into a short, opinionated shortlist of what's genuinely relevant to Carbery.
Build and run small, hands-on prototypes against genuine internal business problems, reaching a clear keep-or-kill verdict on each.
Say no, clearly and in writing, to AI trends that are hype-driven or don't fit Carbery's data and regulatory reality — as often as flagging things worth pursuing.
Own the transition of proven concepts from pilot to full production scale, in partnership with the Digital team and whoever will operate the solution day to day.
Present evidence-based updates at agreed Group Leadership Team sessions, scoped to what has actually been tested and what's being scaled
Manage a budget for licences, prototyping tools and short-term experimentation.
Build the business case for scaling proven pilots into production, jointly with the Group CIO.
Essential Requirements
Meaningful experience (4+ years) in an AI, data, software or automation role, with direct hands-on build experience, not only strategy or advisory exposure.
A demonstrable habit of following AI developments closely — able to speak specifically to what's changed recently
Strong working knowledge of the LLM/SLM landscape, plus awareness of domain-specific and open-source alternatives.
Practical experience building and testing prototypes, proofs of concept or small tools in a real business setting, and taking at least one through to production or live use.
Genuinely immersed in the evolving AI landscape; new models, tools and techniques and able to separate what's real from what's well-marketed.
Clear, confident communication skills, able to present tested findings to senior stakeholders and contribute to strategic direction alongside a more senior sponsor.
Desirable Requirements
A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering or a related field.
Exposure to manufacturing or FMCG environments.
Our Commitment to our People
We are a diverse and growing workforce of over 1,000 people across eight countries globally. As we continue to grow, we want to ensure that Carbery Group continues to be a place where people are supported to develop and feel that they can do their best work. We are committed to driving growth, developing future capability and delivering results through our dedicated teams.
We offer competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and an inclusive workplace where your skills, perspectives, and experience help shape the future of our industry. Join us and be part of a team that values collaboration and makes a meaningful impact - from local communities to global markets.
Carbery Group is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to fostering a supportive work environment.

jobs.title: Customer Assistant - Midleton (25 - 30 hours)
jobs.desc:
About the role
We pride ourselves on offering customers the biggest range of products around. And that's not just food, but everything from clothes and kettles to financial services.
But did you know we offer the biggest job opportunities too? With stores across the UK and Ireland, and a variety of roles, we are always looking for people who are as passionate about helping customers as we are.
Our Every Little Helps approach doesn't just apply to our customers. It's at the very heart of everything we do at work - and it's what makes us different. We believe in treating each other with respect, and everyone having the opportunity to get on. That's what makes Tesco such a great place to work.
Should you be successful in your application, your offer will be subject to and conditional upon you providing your bank account details before your agreed start date.
You will be responsible for
Always put the customer first and consider them in everything you do.
Get to know your customers and serve them with pride.
Help to ensure products and services are available for customers at all times.
Handle all products with care to maintain quality and ensure they reach the customer in the best condition.
Keep the shop floor and back areas clean and tidy at all times.
Using the training you receive, follow department routines and processes.
Follow all company policies and adhere to Health and Safety routines.
Whilst you will have a core role, you may be asked to support your colleagues by helping in other departments.
You will need
Able to give great, natural customer service by proactively smiling, greeting, acknowledging and helping customers.
Works hard for customers, your team and your department.
You are able to prioritise to ensure anything you do is right for our customers.
Adaptable and resilient to meet the ever changing demands of our business.
You must be able to follow instructions either verbal or written.
You are reliable and a good timekeeper.
You must be smart and tidy at all times.
Whats in it for you?
We offer excellent benefits that help make Tesco a great place to work. These include but aren't limited to:
Competitive Salary
Bonus Scheme*
Our Virtual GP service provides free and confidential access to an online GP through video GP consultations, and online prescription service for colleagues. The service is also available to families of colleagues who live at the same address for a reduced cost.
24/7 access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for you and family members for in the moment emotional support along with free access to a range of wellbeing services supporting you under our new Wellbeing First approach of Body, Mind and Life.
Colleague Clubcard offering 10% discount across stores and online, with 15% discount weekends once a month (Friday to Sunday), and 20% off twice a year. There is also 20% off F&F clothing, all year long, these various discounts can be extended to a family member with a 2nd Clubcard available.*
Life Assurance
Pension Plan*
Save As You Earn Scheme*
Paid Family Leave
Bike to Work
Long Service Awards
Commuter Scheme
*Entry requirements and rules of the scheme apply
About Us
Our vision at Tesco is to become every customer's favourite way to shop, whether they are at home or out on the move. Our core purpose is "Serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day". Serving means more than a transactional relationship with our customers. It means acting as a responsible and sustainable business for all stakeholders, for the communities we are part of, and for the planet. Through initiatives like the Tesco Community Fund, our association with Children's Health Foundation, our partnership with FoodCloud and our Stronger Starts programme, we have supported over 21,000 community groups, raised over €7.5 million for medical equipment, and provided almost 15 million meals nationwide, to those living in food insecurity.
Tesco has operated in the Irish retail market since 1997, and with 190+ stores nationwide, we employ over 13,000 people in cities and towns around Ireland, supporting almost 45,000 jobs directly and indirectly. We partner with over 500 Irish suppliers - of which almost three-quarters are small and medium enterprises - which in turn supports almost 13,000 farming families around Ireland. Tesco is the single largest buyer of Irish food and drink in the world, buying €1.6 Billion a year; more than any other single country in the European Union, more than even the USA which you perceive as a massive buyer of Irish food.
We work closely with suppliers across Ireland who are dedicated to making the best products for our customers and this is reflected in the numerous awards our products have won over the years including Blás Na hÉireann, World Steak Challenge and Great Taste Awards.
We are proud to have an inclusive culture at Tesco where everyone truly feels able to be themselves. It is embedded in our values: we treat people how they want to be treated. At Tesco, we not only celebrate diversity, but recognise the value and opportunity it brings. We always want our colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work and we are committed to helping them be at their best.
We know life looks a little different for each of us. That's why at Tesco, we always welcome chats about flexible working. Some people are at the start of their careers, some want the freedom to do the things they love. Others are going through life-changing moments like becoming a carer, nearing retirement, adapting to parenthood, or something else. So, talk to us throughout your application about how we can support.
Tesco is committed to celebrating diversity and everyone is welcome at Tesco. We're committed to providing a fully inclusive recruitment process, allowing candidates the opportunity to thrive and inform us of any reasonable adjustments they may require. For further information on the accessibility support we can offer, please click http://roi.tesco-careers.com/accessibility/
How can I let Tesco know I need additional support?
Please let us know you need additional support by emailing tescoireland.recruitment@tesco.ie
This will allow us to understand more about you and how we can best support you through the recruitment process.

Share your talents
Christmas Sales Advisor
Love connecting with customers? Absolutely thrive in a team? Ready to join Rituals during the most festive time of year?
This might be the perfect seasonal job for you.
Join us during our busiest and most magical time of year. As our Christmas Temp, you'll work in a beautifully decorated boutique that's filled with holiday joy. You're doing much more than selling products or giving customers a quick 'hello' and 'goodbye'. You'll create what we call the Feel Good Experience: our way of making customers feel amazing during the most wonderful time of the year.

Deliver the Feel Good Experience - welcome customers with our signature tea, help them find their favourite products or surprise them with something they never knew they needed.
Hit sales targets - stay sharp on the numbers and challenge yourself with small victories, like perfecting a product story or turning more customers into members.
Handle all the retail essentials - you run the register, take deliveries, and keep the boutique looking sharp and stocked at all times.
Be a brand ambassador - you care about how Rituals looks and feels (from creating beautiful displays to rocking the Rituals look yourself) because you understand that every detail matters for a luxury brand.

Growth opportunities including The Book of Rituals (our learning platform) and coaching on the job to help you grow.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Server Networking Security (Rust)
jobs.desc:
Come join the Server Ingress Security team, where we are rearchitecting MongoDB Server’s ingress networking to make MongoDB clusters even more secure. This new team is building the Atlas Network Protection layer, a set of performant, security-critical services that harden MongoDB's pre-authentication attack surface and provides the ability to respond rapidly to emergent threats. We are looking for talented Senior Engineers to join the team and be founding members, where you will play a crucial role in our multi-year roadmap.
Our team champions a strong culture of inclusivity, diversity, and collaboration. If you want to work on a collaborative team that applies security and systems engineering fundamentals to protect a popular database at scale, join us!
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin or Cork for our hybrid working model.
Candidate Profile
5+ years of experience building production-quality systems software
Experience with large backend/compiled codebases and performance-sensitive software, preferably in Rust
Bonus points for experience working hands-on in security-sensitive or networking-adjacent domains
Strong systems fundamentals, including multi-threaded programming and performance profiling. Bonus points for:
Understanding of network protocols, TLS, and connection lifecycle management
Familiarity with security concepts such as attack surface reduction, input validation, memory safety, and defense-in-depth architectures
Excellent verbal and written technical communication skills, with a strong desire to collaborate with colleagues
Strong time management skills and the ability to realistically assess project complexity
B.Sc. in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with strong competencies in data structures, algorithms, and software design/architecture. Interest in the theory and practice of high-availability, security-critical systems
Position Expectations
Design, implement, and operate production-ready security services in Rust, with a focus on security, correctness, performance, and operational excellence
Develop ingress networking and security solutions that ensure the security, availability, and performance of a database service
Diagnose test failures and performance regressions, and implement fixes
Lead development and project management for features and initiatives within the Ingress Security domain
Collaborate across Server, Atlas, Drivers, SRE, and Product Security teams to ensure the Atlas Network Protection layer integrates seamlessly with the broader MongoDB ecosystem
Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering leadership to define the team's roadmap
Success Measures
In the first month: Understand the high-level architecture of the Atlas Network Protection layer, set up your development environment, and resolve a few bugs
In three months: Contribute substantially to the Rust development of a current project or milestone, take on code review responsibilities, and participate in reviewing designs for new features
In six months: Independently lead the development of a new feature and help mentor new engineers on the team
In twelve months: Drive significant improvements to the security, performance, or operational capabilities of the Ingress Security stack, and contribute to the long-term technical roadmap of the team

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

jobs.title: Analyst/Sr. Analyst - Global HR Solutions - Compliance & AI Governance
jobs.desc:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
This role supports compliance for HR Solutions across a defined set of countries. It contributes to what controls need to be in place, checks that they are working, supports in spotting where the risks are, and keeps the approach up to date as HR uses more AI. It also supports the process for reviewing, approving and monitoring AI and automation used across the employee lifecycle. The role is accountable for checking controls against the agreed standard but does not run the day-to-day controls or deliver the technology.
Key Responsibilities
Compliance framework
Contributes to the design, coherence and effectiveness of the HR Solutions compliance framework end to end, alongside HRS leadership — access management, business continuity, integrity assessment, documentation control and personnel history file governance.
Contribute to the scope, standard and cadence for recurring control activity and help assure the quality of delivery.
Support in maintaining a current view of compliance risk across defined set of regions, escalating and highlighting where local legal, works council or data protection requirements diverge from the global standard.
Identify control gaps arising from process, system or organisational change and advocate for remediation, supporting those remediation activities to closure with accountable owners.
Act as internal point for compliance judgement calls, escalating where needed, and maintain the documented rationale for positions taken.
AI and automation governance
Support the HR Solutions AI governance framework, aligned to best practise, and integrated with enterprise privacy and cyber requirements.
Maintain the register of AI and automated capabilities in use across HR Solutions, with risk tier, intended use, data accessed, accountable owner and review cadence.
Apply the assessment gate before any AI capability touches HR data or employee-facing processes, covering data minimisation, purpose limitation, decision transparency and mandatory human oversight points.
Assess the risks of every AI tool used in people decisions, keep those assessments up to date, and redo them whenever the tool or how it's used changes significantly.
Maintain the documentation a regulator or auditor would request, collected on a defined schedule rather than assembled reactively.
Run ongoing monitoring of AI-enabled processes in production — error patterns, drift, disparate outcomes across employee populations — with defined escalation thresholds.
Assess the risks of vendor AI tools before HR adopts them, including how they handle employee data and which countries' laws apply.
Provide independent challenge to automation proposals. Provide input and challenge on automation proposals from a compliance mindset.
Governance, assurance and capability
Advocate for HR Solutions compliance and assist in ensuring HR Solutions obligations under enterprise compliance, privacy and cyber frameworks are met.
Coordinate periodic assurance activities, including integrity assessment, BCP and BIA, ensuring the quality of what is submitted.
Provide compliance input of cyber security incident response where HR data or processes are affected.
Maintain an informed external view of regulatory direction and emerging practice in HR compliance and AI governance, and highlight any potential impact on the framework to HRS Leadership
Build compliance literacy across HR Solutions, including practical guidance on acceptable AI use in daily work.
Convert recurring findings into recommendations that support structural improvements rather than repeat remediation.
Interface with the DSAR Centre of Excellence
DSAR delivery sits outside this role. The compliance framework nonetheless sets the data protection and AI governance standard against which DSAR processing operates, including any AI applied to search or redaction.
Provide periodic assurance over DSAR decision defensibility and act as escalation point where a DSAR decision raises a framework-level question.
Qualifications & Experience
5+ years compliance, risk, audit or data protection experience in a regulated environment, ideally covering workforce data.
Working knowledge of GDPR applied across multiple jurisdictions, with practical understanding of where local variation materially changes the obligation.
Experience contributing to control framework design and operating effectively within one. Sufficient technical literacy to interrogate how an automated system reaches an output, what data it draws on and where it fails. Not an engineering role, but not one that can accept external assurances at face value.
Ability to hold a position under delivery pressure, and judgement to distinguish material risk from theoretical risk.

You’ll translate strategy into execution, set team direction through OKRs and milestones, and ensure solutions are designed to meet high standards for performance, scalability, security, and reliability. You will play a critical role in shaping the technical and architectural direction of AI solutions, partnering with senior technical leaders to evaluate emerging technologies, make key architecture decisions, and ensure AI innovation translates into scalable, enterprise-ready capabilities and tangible business value.
You’re Great At
Owning: R&D execution, delivery, team performance, and overall operational health.
Leading, scaling and coaching a high-performing team of 20–30 R&D engineers and data scientists through the full R&D lifecycle, from research, experimentation and prototyping, to architecture, engineering, deployment, and production; building strong talent pipelines while fostering technical leadership, innovation, and career development.
Translating complex needs, technologies and concepts into well-defined projects; strategic roadmaps into clear quarterly plans, OKRs, and measurable delivery milestones.
Supporting architecture and system design decisions for complex, enterprise-scale AI solutions.
Assessing & delivering Value to ensure R&D initiatives and product features are directly tied to customer value and measurable business outcomes.
Evaluating emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and architectural approaches and determining how they can be applied to solve real customer and business problems.
Partnering with architects and technical leads to define scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable AI architectures.
Assuring production AI systems consistently meet reliability, performance, and quality SLAs; monitoring and optimizing delivery using KPIs, engineering metrics, and data-driven insights.
Driving cross-functional alignment with Product, Security, Architecture, Platform, and Engineering teams; operational excellence through reliability, scalability, security, and engineering best practices.
What You Need To Succeed
Education: Preferably Master’s degree (strong Bachelor’s considered) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering.
Work Experience: Minimum 8- 12 years of experience in software engineering, AI, data science, or research and development, with progressive technical and leadership responsibility.
R&D Experience: Strong R&D experience, with a track record of taking new technologies or concepts from research, experimentation, and prototyping, through to scalable production solutions; proven experience working within or leading software/AI R&D organizations, ideally developing new products, platforms, or enterprise technology capabilities.
Leadership Experience: Proven success leading and developing mid-sized, multidisciplinary engineering and data science teams; Experience building, scaling, and developing global high-performing engineering teams.
Software Engineering: Strong software and/or AI architecture experience, with the ability to contribute to and guide architecture, system design, technology selection, and technical trade-off decisions.
Software Architecture: Experience designing or overseeing large-scale, distributed, cloud-native architectures, ideally supporting AI, machine learning, data, or enterprise software platforms.
Software Development Programs: Experience managing large-scale software and AI delivery programs from concept and architecture through to production.
Agile Delivery: Experience operating in Agile environments at scale, ideally across globally distributed R&D teams.
Operations: Strong experience operating production systems with a focus on availability, reliability, security, performance, and scalability.
AI Technologies: Strong understanding of AI agents, modern AI architectures, and end-to-end AI solution delivery.
AI Governance: Familiarity with AI governance, responsible AI, security, privacy, and compliance considerations.
Cloud: Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture, distributed systems, APIs, data platforms, and AI deployment platforms.
Execution: Experience driving cross-functional execution across Engineering, Product, Architecture, Security, and Operations.
Organization: Experience establishing team objectives, performance expectations, and career development frameworks; experience managing competing priorities, technical dependencies, and resources in a fast-paced R&D environment.
Mindset: Strong analytical mindset with a data-driven approach to technical and business decision-making.
Balance: Ability to balance innovation and experimentation with architectural rigor and production readiness.
Interpersonal: Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical and business stakeholders at multiple levels.
One Last Thing
OpenText is more than just a corporation; it’s a global community where trust is foundational, the bar is raised, and outcomes are owned. AI is a central pillar of OpenText’s innovation strategy. jobs.title: Sr. Associate/ Manager - HRS AI Enablement
jobs.desc:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
Overview
HR Solutions (HRS) is introducing AI agents that work alongside its HRS team members — drafting, retrieving, checking and, complementing elements of the work that HRS performs today. The intent is to improve the quality, consistency and speed of the support HRS provides, while keeping employees at the centre of the service and retaining the human in the loop where it matters.
This is a newly created team will be accountable for the AI transition in conjunction with the HRS Leadership Team.
Position Purpose
The AI Enablement team is accountable for the adoption and application of AI and new ways of working across HR Solutions, and for the AI agents themselves — their design, quality, guardrails and lifecycle from initial pilot through to retirement, in conjunction with the HRS Leadership Team. This position will also assess and use Lilly-approved AI tools to design and build practical solutions that support the HRS team.
The team co-designs agents with the pods that use them, sets and enforces the quality standards they must meet before and after release, and the capture of how HRS work is performed, on which the agents depend.
This team will act as the positive change agents and advocates for AI adoption. Successful candidates will be comfortable building adoption among HRS pods and declining or withdrawing capability that does not meet the required standard.
Key Objectives and Deliverables
AI adoption and organisational change
Responsible for planning AI across HRS, including readiness assessment, communications, and sequencing
Design and deliver enablement and training, so that HRS team members understand the function of each agent, how to work with it, how to identify unreliable output, and the circumstances in which they should override it
Agent design
Co-design each agent with the advisors and specialists who will use it, working alongside live operations
Define, for each agent, the tasks it drafts, retrieves, decides and completes, and the elements requiring independent human verification
Ensure verification requirements are achievable under operational conditions
Operate a structured feedback route from the pods into the development backlog, and evidence the resulting changes
Quality, guardrails and release approval
Establish the accuracy threshold and evidence standard each agent must satisfy prior to release, and approve or withhold release accordingly
Maintain an evaluation regime based on real cases by country and process, refreshed as policy, content and underlying models change
Knowledge and process capture
Set the standard governing how this knowledge is structured, owned, permissioned and maintained, so that it is usable by both agents and HRS team members
Agent register, monitoring and lifecycle
Maintain the register of agents in operation, recording purpose, scope of action, permissions, data accessed, accountable owner, known limitations and verification requirements
Operate the progression from pilot to production, including the evidence required to extend an agent’s remit or reduce its verification requirement
Monitor performance in live operation and intervene on degradation, including drift following policy change
Withdraw agents that no longer deliver against their benefit case
Governance, privacy and consultation
Ensure each agent carries documented purpose, data use, decision boundaries and human oversight sufficient to satisfy governance requirements
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent professional experience
5+ years experience in HR service delivery, HR operations or shared services, including direct working knowledge of case handling in a multi-country environment
Demonstrated experience in change management within an operational environment, including the enablement and adoption of new ways of working
Experience delivering digital, automation or AI capability into live operations, including requirements definition, pilot delivery and scaling
Evidence of maintaining a quality or governance position under delivery pressure
Additional Skills And Preferences
Working knowledge of HR service platform AI and agent capability
Experience within a global business services or capability centre environment
Additional European language capability

jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer

Translate customer requirements and user specifications into production-ready mechanical designs.
Produce detailed 3D models and 2D manufacturing drawings using CAD software such as Solid Edge, SolidWorks, or Autodesk Inventor.

Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline.

Experience producing manufacturing documentation including GA drawings, fabrication drawings, assembly drawings, and BOMs.
Good understanding of sheet metal design, fabricated assemblies, and design-for-manufacture principles.
Experience supporting fabrication, machining, or assembly teams during project execution.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
Strong communication skills and experience working directly with customers and cross-functional teams.

Pharmaceutical, life sciences, medical device, food, or other regulated manufacturing environments.
Knowledge of GMP and Good Documentation Practices (GDP).

jobs.title: Engineering Quality & Excellence Manager
jobs.desc:
Who We Are
Build what matters. Grow where it counts.
At AMCS, sustainability means business — and careers that create impact. From our roots in Ireland to our teams across Europe, North America and Australasia, we are bringing together ambitious people to help reshape the industries that sustain our world.
What We Build
We build intelligent, cloud-based SaaS solutions that turn complex operations into smarter, more sustainable performance. Powered by AI, data and deep industry expertise, our technology helps customers optimise routes, manage recycling, improve compliance, unlock insight and move faster toward a more efficient, circular future.
Why Join AMCS
Join AMCS and be part of a global team where purpose meets performance. Here, you can grow your career, challenge what’s possible and work on technology that makes a measurable difference — for our customers, our communities and the planet.
Due to the continued level of growth at AMCS, we have an opportunity for a highly motivated and experienced Engineering Quality & Excellence Manager.
This role exists to scale engineering standards and quality practices across the entire global Engineering organisation. It defines what good engineering looks like at AMCS, measures whether the organisation is actually doing it, and drives Engineering Managers to close the gaps.
This role becomes the operational owner of the engineering excellence system: senior Engineering leadership sets strategy and expectations; this role turns those expectations into standards, measurement, governance and improvement programmes; Engineering Managers remain accountable for implementing them in their teams.
What You'll Do
Define, own and evolve the global engineering standards that describe what good engineering looks like across all products and teams — covering source control, code review, CI/CD, testing, static analysis, security and observability.
Own the global engineering maturity model and the scorecard derived from it, running assessments that give senior Engineering leadership a credible view of quality, risk and trend.
Use data to identify systemic quality and engineering risk, and drive improvement programmes with Engineering Managers, holding them accountable for closing gaps in their own teams.
Provide strategic leadership to the Quality Engineering function through the Quality Engineering Manager, targeting quality engineering investment at the highest-risk areas.
Act as the central Engineering point of contact for engineering-related compliance and audit requirements, translating them into concrete engineering expectations and coordinating Engineering's response.
Partner with Engineering Managers on capability building while holding the line on standards — leading primarily through influence and credible data rather than line authority.
Own reporting to senior Engineering leadership — providing the metrics, updates and status on engineering quality and maturity.
What You'll Bring
Substantial experience in senior engineering, engineering quality or engineering excellence leadership roles within a multi-product software organisation.
Deep understanding of modern engineering practice — source control strategy, code review, CI/CD, test automation strategy, static analysis, performance engineering, observability and secure development — with enough depth to credibly challenge Engineering Managers on any of them.
Strong command of engineering and quality metrics, and the judgement to distinguish a meaningful signal from a metric that will be gamed.
Proven ability to drive change across organisational boundaries through influence, evidence and governance rather than line authority.
Experience defining and running a maturity model, assessment framework or engineering standards programme at scale.
Experience of regulatory or audit frameworks such as SOC 2, PCI DSS or ISO 27001 from the engineering side, including evidence and remediation.
Comfortable operating globally across time zones, cultures and engineering teams with different histories and maturity levels.
Credible with engineers without needing to be a hands-on developer — genuine technical literacy and the confidence to hold a technical argument.
Resilient and direct, able to deliver unwelcome findings to peers and hold the standard under delivery pressure.
How Success Will Be Measured (first 12 Months)
Demonstrable improvement in engineering maturity scores across the portfolio, with the weakest teams improving fastest.
Reduction in customer-found and escaped defects, and improvement in release quality.
Increased consistency of engineering practice across products, measured against the standards rather than asserted.
Engineering quality risk identified proactively from data rather than surfacing through customer impact or escalation.
Engineering compliance obligations met on time, with evidence available and audits passing without engineering-side surprises.
Quality Engineering investment demonstrably targeted at the highest-risk areas.
Engineering Managers treating the scorecard as a useful management tool rather than an imposed reporting exercise.

jobs.title: Customer Assistant - Ballyvolane

From our Head Office to the shop floor and everywhere in between our primary goal is to create and deliver a fantastic customer journey for everyone who shops at Lidl.
Customer obsessed, high energy and love learning every day?
If that sounds like you, earn €460+ per week as a Customer Assistant on our standard 30 hour contract.

What you'll do
Interacting with the customer in a pleasant, friendly and helpful manner
Ensuring stock loss controls are followed in all areas of the store
Maintaining store and external cleanliness and hygiene standards
Following freshness and rotation principles
Ensuring all waste is managed correctly
Assisting in the stock count process
What you'll need
A can-do attitude and excellent customer service skills
The willingness to go the extra mile for our customers
To be responsible and reliable
To enjoy working in a fast-paced, varied environment
A good team player
Preferably, previous experience in a customer facing role but this is not essential provided you have the right attitude

We offer a competitive and transparent salary system, that ensures pay equality across all positions at Lidl
€15.40 rising to €17.90 per hour after 3 years (supplementary pay outlined below)
Unsocial hours worked (12am to 7am)
20 days holidays per annum pro rata
Company pension
Unlock a flex pot allowance to spend on a selection of benefits after 6 months of service
Genuine opportunities for career development
Individuals recognised as high performing will be invited to join our Leadership Academy as part of your on-going development
Circle K and Private Health Insurance discounts available for all employees
Bike to Work Scheme

Real-world evidence and clinical consulting

Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to recruitment@alimentiv.com.
Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams
Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process.
Official communication will only come from company email addresses containing "@alimentiv.com". If you are contacted about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender's email address and confirm that you are being asked to apply on this website. If something doesn't feel right, we encourage you to verify before responding. If you believe you have been the victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report it.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. South East Technological University (SETU) is a dynamic higher education institution whose mission is to engage, learn, challenge, and innovate. Role Description
This full-time, on-site Post-Doctoral Researcher role is based in County Waterford, Ireland and focuses on the BioShore project investigating biostimulants derived from seaweeds. The post-doc will design and execute laboratory experiments related to seaweed-based biostimulants, including extraction, characterization, and evaluation of their effects on plant growth and resilience. Candidates should possess Teaching and mentoring abilities to support student supervision, training in laboratory methods, and occasional contributions to instructional activities.
PhD in a relevant discipline (e.g., Biotechnology, Plant Science, Marine Science, Chemistry, Environmental Science, or related field).

Proficiency in scientific writing, including preparation of manuscripts, reports, and grant proposals.
Ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams, manage project timelines, and communicate results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

jobs.desc:

You see the world through a unique lens and that’s exactly what we need. We embrace how you see things differently – it’s essential for creating a sustainable future.

We are currently seeking a Work Placement geoenvironmental scientist/engineer to join our specialist Ground Engineering team in Cork or Dublin, Ireland. Evaluating alternative mixed-signal subsystem implementation architectures.

MS Electrical Engineering.
7+ years of mixed-signal integrated circuit development experience.
Strong understanding of data converter architectures and specifications and/or deep understanding of SerDes PHY architectures and specifications
Deep understanding of mixed-signal design fundamentals, design tools, and methodologies.

Successful experience developing challenging mixed-signal integrated circuits for commercial applications.
